pages.title: Getting started
pages.summary: Signing in, the menu, Home tasks, favourites, and signing out.
pages.text: Signing in 1. Open the ERP's address in your browser Chrome, Edge, Safari or Firefox . 2. On Sign In , enter: Corporate ID : your organisation's ID, given by your administrator; Email or user ID and Password : your own ERP account. The user ID is your Username in User Management; your email works as before. 3. Select Sign In . You arrive at the menu the Module Hierarchy . The Corporate ID decides which organisation's ERP you sign in to. The field starts empty; your browser can save it with your sign in and offer it next time. The Employee Portal asks for the same Corporate ID, then your Employee Code and password. If two users were given the same user ID before user IDs had to be unique, they sign in with their email until one is renamed. If the ERP says your account is inactive or not configured, ask your administrator: an account must be active and assigned to at least one company and role. Forgot your password? On the sign in page, open Forgot Password , enter your Corporate ID and email address and select Send Reset Link . A link to set a new password arrives by email. The link works once and for an hour: if it has expired, ask for a new one the same way. Once signed in, you can change your password at any time from the user menu your name, top right → Change Password . The menu The menu is a tree of areas Finance, Procurement, Inventory and so on . You see only the screens your role allows. The title above the menu names your company: your only company, or else the main one reference code 01 of the companies you are assigned. When a company is assigned to you, it shows as soon as you come back to Home. Choosing your companies With more than one company, the button after the title All companies at first chooses which of them you work in. Tick the companies and select Apply : The screens offer only the companies you chose in their company lists, and with one chosen they fill it in for you, as for a user with only one company. The title then names it. It's a filter, not a change of what you may do: every company is still yours, and Select all brings them all back. A document already saved for another company still shows its company. Your choice is kept for the next time you sign in, on any computer. For example, an accountant assigned Example Trading and Example Services who works on Example Services all week chooses it alone, and no longer picks the company on each entry. Select an area to open it; select a screen to start working in it. Search modules top bar : type part of a screen's name to filter the menu. Enter opens the screen when only one matches; Esc clears the search. The double arrow button expands or collapses the whole tree. Without the mouse: F2 goes to Search modules. ↓ moves to the first row shown, and ↑ ↓ move through the menu. → opens an area or folder and ← closes it. Enter opens a screen. Tab reaches the same rows, each outlined when it has the focus. Inside a screen, Back to Hierarchy returns to the menu. If you have unsaved changes, the ERP asks before leaving. Favourites Put the screens you use most at the top of the menu: user menu → Configure Favourites , select the star next to each screen you want, then Done . Until you choose your own, you see your role's defaults, if your administrator has set some Roles & Permissions roles.html . Home tasks The Tasks button top bar shows what is waiting for you, with a count. Select a line to open that document. What you may see, depending on your role: Block What it means Your Pending Approvals Documents waiting for your approval. Rejected — Needs Your Resubmission Your documents an approver rejected, with the reason. Correct and submit again, or Close one you will not resubmit Approvals approvals.html rejected documents . Ready for You to Act On Approved documents your team follows up for example, raising the purchase order for an approved requisition . The teams are set in Approval Configuration. My Drafts — Not Yet Submitted or Posted Documents you saved as drafts. Post dated Cheques Due to Clear Cheques whose date has come. Recurring Journal Entries Due to Post Recurring entries whose date has come. Company / Employee Documents Expiring Licences, contracts or employee documents near or past expiry. Employee Requests Waiting for You Employees' queries, loan requests, claims and requests of the types HR sets up, to handle an overdue one says so . Clearances Waiting for You A leaver's clearance step for your team to sign off Clearances clearances.html . How approvals work is explained in Approvals approvals.html . The user menu Select your name top right for: My Portal : your own leave, payslips and requests, when your ERP user is linked to an employee record; Light mode / Dark mode : your choice is kept with you, on every computer you sign in on. The ERP starts in light mode until you choose; Configure Favourites ; Refresh : reloads the menu after an administrator changed it or your rights ; Change Password ; Log Out . Help The Help button top bar , or F1 , opens this help in a new tab. Inside a screen, it opens that screen's page directly. Help uses the ERP's light or dark theme; its Light mode / Dark mode button switches both. Back to the ERP top of every Help page closes Help and returns you to the ERP where you were; in the installed app, where Help has no back button of its own, this is the way back. On a phone, each page starts with its own text; All pages jumps to the list of every page, below. Signing out, and the automatic sign out Use Log Out in the user menu when you finish, especially on a shared computer. After 10 minutes without activity the ERP warns you, and signs you out 30 seconds later unless you select Stay Signed In . Anything not saved is lost, so save drafts as you go. Installing the app The ERP and the Employee Portal can each be installed as an app, with its own icon ERP and Employee Portal and its own window. On a computer Chrome or Edge : open the ERP, then click the Install icon at the right of the address bar. On an Android phone : open the page in Chrome, then use the menu ⋮ → Add to Home screen or Install app . On an iPhone or iPad : open the page in Safari, then use Share → Add to Home Screen . Once installed, the app opens quickly: its pages and styles are kept on the device, and a newer version is fetched each time you open it. You still sign in as usual. Everything you open or save goes to the server, so the app needs a connection: without one it says You're offline , and nothing is saved. On a phone The ERP works on a phone for looking things up and approving; data entry is for a computer. Home fits the phone's screen: the menu, the search and your tasks. Approvals open as a compact card, where you approve or reject Approvals approvals.html on a phone . These reports fit the phone's screen : Trial Balance trial balance.html and the aging reports Customer and Vendor Aging aging reports.html , Inventory Aging inventory aging.html keep their first column fixed; swipe the table sideways for the other figures; Stock Availability stock availability.html and the statements of account statements of account.html show each row as a card, each figure with its heading. Their filters wrap to the phone's width. Copy to Excel and Print are better done on a computer. Every other screen opens at a computer's width, as before: pinch to zoom. A notice says This screen is best on a computer ; close it with × and it stays closed until you close the ERP's tab or app. Nothing changes on a computer or a tablet. Next Working with screens working with screens.html : dates, drafts and posting, Copy to Excel, printing, supporting documents, closed months. Approvals approvals.html .

pages.title: Working with screens
pages.summary: What every screen has in common: companies, dates, drafts and posting, messages, Copy to Excel, printing, attachments and closed months.
pages.text: Company first The ERP holds several companies. Most screens start with a Company choice; you see only the companies assigned to you, and of those only the ones you chose at the top of Home see Choosing your companies getting started.html choosing your companies . When you have only one, or chose one, it is chosen for you. Lists, numbers and reports always belong to the company chosen. Item codes An item with a user code of your own shows it in place of its item code on every screen, print and copy, and you can type either where you enter an item. See Item Master item master.html your own item code . Dates and periods Dates show as dd/mm/yyyy 31/12/2026 and months as Sep 2026 , everywhere: on screen, in print and in what you copy to Excel. To enter a date, use the date field's calendar. Drafts, submitting and posting Entry screens journals, invoices, receipts and so on follow the same steps: 1. New opens an empty document. Fill the header company, date, party and the lines. 2. Save Draft keeps your work without any effect on the books or stock. Drafts appear in Home tasks under My Drafts , and you can change or delete them. 3. Submit or Post : where an approval is set up for that document, Submit sends it to the approver see Approvals approvals.html ; otherwise Post records it: the accounting entry and any stock movement are made, and the document gets its number. 4. A posted document cannot be edited. To correct it, Reverse it a mirror entry, dated in an open month and enter it again. The list on each entry screen shows documents by status; search and open any of them. Finding an account, item, customer or vendor Wherever you choose an account, an item, a customer, a vendor or another entry from a long list, you can search it: In a code box the account on a journal line, the item on a GRN line , start typing. The matches show under the box straight away. Type any part of the code or the name: "trad" finds both Trade Payables and Beta Trading . Codes that start with what you typed come first, then names. Choose with the mouse, or with the arrow keys and Enter after the arrow keys, Tab also chooses . Esc closes the list and keeps what you typed. In a long drop down a customer or vendor on a document, a journal line's party , click it or start typing a letter: a search box opens above the list. The last five entries you chose from each list appear first, under Recent . They are kept in this browser. On a phone the list fills the screen, with a box to type in. Short drop downs a status, a company work as before. The list offers the same entries as before: for example, a journal offers only the company's postable accounts. Messages and questions Messages, confirmations "Post this document?" and questions for example a reason for a reversal appear in a box inside the ERP. Read them before choosing: Cancel always leaves things as they were. Long lists Document lists journal entries, cash and bank, GRNs, purchase orders and others show the newest entries first, a page at a time. Load next adds the following page below. Searching and filtering look through every entry, not only the ones shown. Rows beside the count sets how many a page holds: 25, 50 or 100. The choice is remembered in this browser for every list. Copy to Excel and printing Copy on lists and reports copies the table; paste it into Excel and each value lands in its own cell. Entry screens with lines journal entries, cash and bank, GRNs, the requisitions, sales orders and others have Copy Table and Paste from Excel : copy the lines with their headings, fill them in Excel and paste them back. The headings row is skipped, and a paste with a wrong row is refused whole, naming the rows to fix. Print prints the report or document without the menus and buttons. To keep a PDF, choose "Save as PDF" as the printer. Printed documents invoices, vouchers, orders, delivery notes and the like share one look: their tables have a light, rounded frame and light lines between the cells. Payslips keep their own layout. Linked documents and Create next On the documents of a sale or a purchase requisitions, Purchase Orders, Goods Receipts, Vendor Invoices, Sales Orders, Delivery Notes, Customer Invoices, and the payments and receipts that settle them , a Linked documents section sits just above the supporting documents: Create next has a button for each step the document can still be followed by, for example Delivery Note on an approved Sales Order with quantity still to deliver, or Receipt and PDC Received on an invoice with an amount still open shown beside them . The button opens the next screen with a new document already started: the company, the customer or vendor, and this document chosen. Check it, change what you need for example the quantities, or Cash instead of Bank , then save it as usual. Nothing is saved until you do. Comes from and Followed by list the documents before and after it, for example on an invoice its Sales Order and Delivery Notes, and the receipts, cheques and credit notes settling it. Select a number to open that document. You see a button or a link only for the screens you may open and, for Create next, create documents in . When a document is fully delivered, received, invoiced or paid, its Create next buttons go. From Create next Purchase Requisition, Inventory Purchase Requisition Purchase Order Purchase Order Goods Receipt Goods Receipt Vendor Invoice Vendor Invoice Payment Cash and Bank , PDC Issued Sales Order Delivery Note; Customer Invoice where the company lets invoices deliver Delivery Note Customer Invoice Customer Invoice Receipt Cash and Bank , PDC Received Supporting documents Entry screens have a Supporting documents section: Add files to keep the vendor's bill, a delivery note or a receipt with the document. Files are stored in the company's document storage, and anyone who can open the document can open its files. Closed months Finance closes each month after its checks Period Closing . Once a month is closed, nothing can be posted, reversed or approved with a date in it; the ERP says which month is closed. Use a date in an open month, or ask someone with the reopen right to reopen the month. Drilling down and going back Reports link to their detail a Trial Balance line to its ledger, a ledger line to its document . Use Back to … on the opened screen to return to the report where you left it. You can leave a screen at any time, even while it is still loading: what it was loading is dropped, and nothing on it is saved unless you saved it. Saving your place The ERP signs you out after 10 minutes without activity with a warning . Save drafts as you go on long entries.

pages.title: Approvals
pages.summary: How documents are submitted, approved, rejected and delegated.
pages.text: When a document needs approval An administrator decides, per document type and company, whether documents need approval and by whom Approval Configuration . Rules can depend on the amount, and a document can need several approvers one after another. When a rule applies, Submit sends the document for approval instead of posting it. Approving 1. Your pending approvals appear in Home tasks under Your Pending Approvals . 2. Select one to open the document. Check it, and its attachments. 3. Choose Approve , or Reject with a reason. A reason is required to reject. When the last approver approves, the document is posted or, for an order or a request, becomes approved for the next step . Where a follow up team is set in Approval Configuration for example Procurement for approved requisitions , the document appears in that team's Home tasks under Ready for You to Act On . On a phone On a phone, selecting a pending approval opens an approval card instead of the full screen: the document's number, date, party and amount, its lines in short, who submitted it, and each level's decision so far. Approve and Reject with a reason there do exactly what they do on the document's screen, with the same rights and levels. Open the full document shows everything else, such as attachments. A few kinds of approval a Job Order line, a reimbursement claim, an absence need more than approve or reject; their card offers the full document only. See On a phone getting started.html on a phone . Rejected documents A rejected document returns to its submitter, with the reason, under Rejected — Needs Your Resubmission . Correct it and submit it again. It leaves your tasks once it is submitted again, or posted a corrected document that no longer needs approval posts at once . If it will not be submitted again, choose Close on it. It leaves your tasks, and the rejection stays on record, marked "Closed, not resubmitted"; the document itself is not changed. Its submitter or an Admin can close it an Admin from Approval Tracker approval tracker.html . Following a document Approval Tracker shows where every submitted document is: who has approved it, who it is waiting for, and since when. When an approver is away From Approval Tracker, an approver can delegate their own pending approvals, and an administrator can delegate anyone's, to another user who has access to that screen and company. A reason is required for example "On annual leave" ; who delegated, to whom and when is recorded. Closed months An approval that would post into a closed month is refused; see Working with screens working with screens.html closed months .

pages.title: What's new
pages.summary: The latest changes to the ERP, newest first, with a link to each screen's page.
pages.text: The latest changes, newest first. Each links to the page that explains the screen. 30/10/2026 Help on a phone. Every Help page has Back to the ERP , the way back from Help in the installed app. On a phone a page starts with its own text, not the list of pages; All pages jumps to the list. Bold text that ran over two lines in a list now shows as bold. See Help getting started.html help . The ERP on a phone. Home, your tasks and the chosen reports Trial Balance, aging, Stock Availability, the statements of account now fit a phone's screen. A pending approval opens as a compact card where you approve, or reject with a reason. Other screens stay at a computer's width, with a notice you can close. See On a phone getting started.html on a phone . Install the ERP and the Employee Portal as apps. Each has its own icon and window and opens faster, because its pages and styles are kept on the device. Pages also load faster in the browser. See Installing the app getting started.html installing the app . Exchange rates from the sheet. In Currency Configuration currencies.html , Get rates from the sheet reads the firm's Google Sheet of rates and shows each beside your last one. A move of more than 5% is marked. You tick the rates to use and apply them; none applies on its own. Tax Reports. The new Tax Reports tax reports.html screen works out a company's tax for a period from its posted documents: the tax summary, UAE VAT 201, and India's GSTR 1 the GST offline tool's sheets and GSTR 3B. Each figure opens its documents, and each table copies to Excel. Documents posted with one tax % before line tax are listed apart. India's B2CL limit is set in Tax Configuration tax configuration.html . Retail Sales, asset sales and orders taxed by code. For a company with a Tax Configuration, Retail Sales retail sales.html takes each line's tax out of its price by the item's code, posts each component to its account and prints it on the receipt; returns give back each line's share. An asset sale in Fixed Asset Retirement fixed asset retirement.html takes a tax code. Sales Orders sales order.html , their Proforma Invoices and Purchase Orders purchase order.html show the estimated tax and the total with tax. Vendor Invoices taxed line by line. For a company with a Tax Configuration, each Vendor Invoice vendor invoice.html line takes its tax code from its item, or from its account's new default code in the Chart of Accounts chart of accounts.html , with GST from the vendor's state. The part of the tax a code lets you reclaim goes to the input accounts. The rest is cost: the line's own account, or the goods' cost in stock. Reverse charge posts the tax both ways. Purchase Returns purchase return.html take back their share. Changing a line's code needs the new change tax code right. 26/10/2026 Invoices taxed line by line. For a company with a Tax Configuration, each Customer Invoice customer invoice.html line now takes its tax code from its item or Sales Type, at the rate on the invoice date: standard, zero rated and exempt lines on one invoice, GST as CGST + SGST or IGST by the place of supply, and prices that include tax from a price list price listing.html marked so. Each component posts to its own account and prints with its rate; Sales Returns sales return.html take back their share. Changing a line's code needs the new change tax code right. India's e invoice, ready. Under India GST, each posted invoice and credit note to a registered business, an SEZ or a customer abroad gets its e invoice as the IRP's JSON, checked for what it needs GSTINs, addresses and PIN codes, HSN codes and downloadable from the invoice. See Sales Invoice Configuration sales invoice setup.html . Customers and vendors gain a City and PIN code customer master.html . Tax Configuration, for VAT, GST or a tax of your own. Each company now sets its sales tax in Tax Configuration tax configuration.html : UAE VAT or India GST ready made, or its own, with each component's accounts and its tax codes rated by date. Items take a tax code and HSN / SAC; customers and vendors a registration type, state or emirate, and a checked GSTIN or TRN. Invoices start using it in the next release. Sales reps' receipts, final at once. A rep's collection in the Employee Portal now gives the customer its receipt straight away, numbered from the rep's own series RC AK 000001 , shared as a PDF from the phone. The rep picks the invoices it pays, and sees the cash and cheques they hold. The cashier takes the cash with a Cash Receipt that chooses the rep; the office ticks the cheques received from the rep. See Sales reps sales rep portal.html , set up in Sales Invoice Configuration sales invoice setup.html sales reps . 25/10/2026 Request types of your own. In Employee Requests employee requests.html request types HR sets up the requests employees raise from the portal: a salary certificate, IT support … each with its own form, straight to its handler or through the line manager first, an optional time to answer overdue shown , and a document as the answer. Employees find them under Requests → Other ; numbered RQ . Leaver clearance. The new Clearances clearances.html screen takes each leaver through the company's steps Finance, IT, HR by default , each signed off by its team, with a checklist and any amount to recover. The final settlement goes for approval once every step is signed; the leaver follows it in the Employee Portal. Hold a salary. Payroll's new Salary holds tab stops an employee's salary from a month: the payslip shows a Stop Salary deduction and the amount waits on a Salary held account set it in Payroll Setup . Released, it is paid with the next run. See Payroll payroll run.html hold an employee s salary . Several post dated cheques in one entry. Enter a customer's or vendor's set of cheques at once, with a Monthly series for a run of monthly cheques. They post under one number, 01, 02 …, and each then clears or bounces by itself. See Post dated Cheques post dated cheques.html record a cheque or a set of cheques . Create next, and linked documents. From a Sales Order, Delivery Note, invoice, requisition, Purchase Order or Goods Receipt, Create next starts the next document already filled in, and Linked documents lists the documents before and after it, each opened from its number. See Working with screens working with screens.html linked documents and create next . 24/10/2026 Your own item codes. Give an item a User code in Item Master item master.html your own item code : it shows in place of the item code everywhere, and you can type it wherever you enter an item. What reserved stock is for. In Stock Availability stock availability.html , select a Reserved quantity to see the Sales Orders reserving it, and open one from there. New Ref shown in Allocate. When matching a payment to bills, and in Re match, the part left over shows as its own New Ref line, and All as New Ref makes the whole line an advance. See Paying and allocating payments and allocation.html fixing a wrong pick re match . Proforma Invoice from a Sales Order. Print a saved Sales Order as a Proforma Invoice with its own PI number, the same on every reprint; a draft prints marked DRAFT. See Sales Order sales order.html proforma invoice . Choose your companies at the top. With more than one company, the button after the title chooses which of them the screens offer; with one chosen, they fill it in for you. Your choice is kept for the next sign in. See Getting started getting started.html choosing your companies . Sign in with your user ID. On the sign in page, enter your email or your user ID your Username in User Management . Usernames are now unique in your organisation. See Getting started getting started.html signing in . Default favourites per role. In Roles & Permissions roles.html , the star on a role sets up to 5 favourites for its users who haven't chosen their own. Nobody's own favourites are changed. Light or dark, everywhere you sign in. Your choice of Light mode or Dark mode now goes with you to every computer. The ERP starts in light mode until you choose. See Getting started getting started.html the user menu . The menu by keyboard. F2 goes to Search modules, the arrow keys move through the menu, Enter opens a screen, and F1 opens Help. See Getting started getting started.html the menu . Data Reset covers every module. It can now clear HR and payroll employees, leave, payroll runs and payslips, settlements, loans, requests , Sales and Purchase Orders, Job Orders, vendors, customers, price lists, supporting documents, and a new Setup group. It refuses to clear a master still in use, and says what uses it. Clearing employees also removes their Employee Portal sign ins. Clearing supporting documents moves their files to the storage's trash. See Data Reset data reset.html . Leaving Reasons are in HR Setup. The list moved from Payroll Setup to HR Setup hr setup.html leaving reasons , with the same reasons. Who may change it is now the HR Setup right. Employees choose from it as before. An export invoice prints in the customer's currency only. A Customer Invoice in a foreign currency with no VAT no longer shows the rate and amounts in the default currency on its print. With VAT, they still show. See Customer Invoice customer invoice.html a customer in a foreign currency . Chart of Accounts: a renumbered account's old code is in its details. The list no longer shows "formerly …" under it; open the account Edit to see its former codes and until when. See Chart of Accounts chart of accounts.html . More room on wide screens. Employees employees.html and Sales Order sales order.html use the width of a wide monitor, and the Sales Order's item names have more space. Other screens keep the usual width. Production Entry opens complete. An entry opened while the screen was still loading showed its items as "not found" and its Job Order as not linked. It now waits for the lists, and a posted entry's Job Order shows by its number even once it is complete. See Production Entry production.html . No error after going Back while a screen loads. Leaving a screen for example PDC Received or PDC Issued before it has finished loading, by Back or by opening another module, no longer shows an error message. See Working with screens working with screens.html . Rejected documents leave your tasks when they should. A rejected document that you correct and post without approval for example at a lower amount no longer stays under Rejected in your Home tasks. Close a rejection you will not resubmit. Choose Close on it in your Home tasks; an Admin can also close one in Approval Tracker. The rejection stays on record as "Closed, not resubmitted". See Approvals approvals.html rejected documents . 23/10/2026 Your company's name on Home without a reload. When a company is assigned to you, the title above the menu shows it as soon as you come back to Home. See Getting started getting started.html the menu . A menu folder can no longer be linked to a module. In Tree Management tree management.html , an item either opens a screen or holds sub items, and a top level item an area of the menu never opens a screen. A folder linked to a module by mistake now stays in the menu, with everything under it, so it can be put right. 22/10/2026 Support. Your Admin can send an issue a bug, a question or a change you need to the ERP's support team from Support support.html , with up to 5 screenshots or files, and follow their answers there. What you send is shared with the support team: the screen asks you to confirm it each time. 19/10/2026 The Corporate ID field starts empty. On the sign in page getting started.html , Forgot Password and the Employee Portal, type your Corporate ID; your browser can save it and offer it next time. Sign in by Corporate ID. The sign in page getting started.html now uses the Corporate ID to choose which organisation's ERP you sign in to. Forgot Password and the Employee Portal ask for the Corporate ID too. Nothing else changes when you sign in. 18/10/2026 Production and cheques post all at once. Posting a Production Entry production.html now updates its Job Order lines and reserves what it made for their Sales Orders in the same step, and posting, clearing, bouncing or cancelling a post dated cheque post dated cheques.html writes its GL entry and the cheque together. If anything stops the posting, nothing of it is saved. Goods receipts and vendor invoices post all at once. Posting a GRN goods receipt note.html now updates the quantities received on its Purchase Orders in the same step, and posting a Vendor Invoice vendor invoice.html marks its GRNs in the same step. If anything stops the posting, nothing of it is saved, so you can correct it and post again. 17/10/2026 Renumbering an account updates the stock documents too. When you renumber an account in the Chart of Accounts chart of accounts.html , GRNs, issues, deliveries, returns and the other stock documents now show its new code as well, like every other document. Deliveries and customer invoices post all at once. Posting a Delivery Note delivery note.html now updates its Sales Orders and reservations in the same step, and posting a Customer Invoice customer invoice.html marks its deliveries in the same step. If anything stops the posting, nothing of it is saved, so you can correct it and post again. 16/10/2026 Sales reps in the Employee Portal. A Sales tab for employees the office makes sales reps Sales Invoice Configuration → Sales reps : their customers with balances, orders at the price list sent to the office as draft Sales Orders, and cash or cheque collections recorded for the office to post. See Sales reps in the Employee Portal sales rep portal.html . E invoicing, ready. Switch it on per company in Sales Invoice Configuration sales invoice setup.html , from a date: each posted Customer Invoice and Sales Return to a customer with a TRN gets its UAE e invoice PINT AE , checked, with its status and the XML to download. It is sent once your Accredited Service Provider is chosen and connected; nothing is sent before. Projects, and which accounts need a cost center. A Project is a new kind of Organizational Unit, with a customer and dates; a Closed one takes no new postings. Journal and Cash and Bank lines take a project, and an invoice's project goes on all its lines. In the Chart of Accounts each heading and any account says whether its lines need a cost center, profit center and project: Required, Optional or Not used. Nothing changes until you set it: expenses still need a cost center. The new Project Report project report.html shows each project's income, costs and result; the GL Report, Trial Balance and P&L filter by project. See Organizational Units org units.html and Chart of Accounts chart of accounts.html . Vendors and customers in a foreign currency. A vendor or customer whose Default Currency is, say, USD is invoiced, paid and given its statement in USD. Enter rates by date in Currency Configuration → Rates 1 USD = 3.6725 AED from a date until the next rate and choose each company's Exchange Gain / Loss account. Customer and Vendor Invoices take the rate on their date another rate needs a reason ; in Cash and Bank you enter the USD amount beside the amount, and a difference from the bills' rates posts as an exchange gain or loss. Statements and aging show USD with the AED beside it. For now: USD invoices take direct lines and item lines for customers , not GRNs or separate Delivery Notes. Journal Entries and Post dated Cheques take the USD amount too, and Opening Balances take open documents in USD with their rate. A bank account can be in USD Chart of Accounts → Currency : its vouchers are in USD and its ledger shows the USD balance. A printed USD invoice shows the VAT and the total in AED. See Currency Configuration currencies.html , Customer Invoice customer invoice.html , Vendor Invoice vendor invoice.html , Cash and Bank cash and bank.html and Statements of account statements of account.html . Item categories of your own. Besides the five, add a category such as Spare Parts with New category… in the item form. It has its own code prefix SP 000001 and behaves like one of the five for BOMs and production. It can be shared or belong to one company, and can have its own sub categories. See Item Master item master.html . Chart of Accounts: classes, groups and renumbering. Codes now have a level each: a class per type 100000 Assets , groups under it 110000 Cash and the accounts under a group 110001 . An account can no longer sit straight under a class. Cash and bank accounts are the ones under a group marked Cash or Bank , not those with a certain code. Renumber gives a used account another code in its own group, and every entry and document follows. See Chart of Accounts chart of accounts.html . Search any long list. Choosing an account, item, customer, vendor or a line's party now opens a searchable list. Type any part of the code or name "trad" finds Beta Trading , choose with the arrow keys and Enter, and find your recent choices at the top. On a phone it fills the screen. See Working with screens working with screens.html . End of service statement. A final settlement now prints an End of Service Settlement Statement for the employee Print statement . It shows the service, the gratuity worked out by slab, entitlements, deductions and the net, in figures and in words. It is marked DRAFT until posted. Once the settlement is paid, the employee also finds it in the Employee Portal under My payslips . See Final Settlement payroll final settlement.html . Sell from stock on the invoice. Where a company switches it on Sales Invoice Configuration → Invoices may deliver stock directly , a Customer Invoice can have item lines , typed or brought in From Sales Order . When it is posted, the invoice delivers them itself: a Delivery Note is made for them, the stock leaves at its cost and the order counts them as delivered. Print delivery slip prints the items without prices. See Customer Invoice customer invoice.html . Payroll: share an employee's cost across cost centers. A Transfer in Employee Change can now set a cost split by % for example 60% / 40% . Every payroll expense of the employee is then shared that way. In a draft payroll run you can also change one employee's cost center or split for this run only , with a reason. The payslip now shows the cost center it posted to, even after a later transfer. See Employee Change employee change.html and Payroll Run payroll run.html . Paste lines from Excel into Purchase Requisition, Inventory Purchase Requisition and Sales Order: Copy Table gives the columns also on an empty grid , Paste from Excel adds the rows. A row that isn't right stops the paste and is named. On a Sales Order the price list's price is used where the item has one. See Purchase Requisition purchase requisition.html , Inventory Purchase Requisition inventory purchase requisition.html and Sales Order sales order.html . Fix a payment's matching without reversing it. A posted payment or receipt that settles the wrong bill: open it and select Re match references , choose again, and give the reason. The books don't change, and it works in a closed month. It needs the new rematch right. See Paying and allocating payments and allocation.html . Month end checklist: a new check for deliveries posted but not invoiced ; your own accounts that must be zero at month end clearing accounts ; and your own steps to tick before closing. See Period Closing period closing.html . Retail counter: find a customer by code, name or mobile number; an unknown mobile can become a new customer there. A mobile number now belongs to one customer of a company, also in Customer Master. See Retail Sales retail sales.html and Customer Master customer master.html . Shareholders in Company Master , with their % of the issued shares, their history and a printed company profile. They are se

pages.title: Chart of Accounts
pages.summary: The list of accounts every entry posts to: heads and postable accounts, types, codes, and shared accounts.
pages.text: Chart of Accounts What it is for Every amount the ERP records lands on an account in the Chart of Accounts COA . The COA is a tree of six digit codes, a level each: Level Code Example Class: one per type, a heading X00000 100000 Assets Group: a heading under the class XN0000 110000 Cash / Petty Cash Sub group optional : under a group XNM000 121000 Current accounts Account: takes postings XN0001–XN0999, XNM001–XNM999 110001 Petty cash The classes and the main groups Cash, Bank, Receivables, Inventory, Payables, Share Capital, Retained Earnings, Sales, Cost of Sales, Salaries and others are there from the start. An account that takes postings always sits under a group or a sub group, never straight under a class. Before you start You need the Chart of Accounts right for your role Roles & Permissions . Decide which accounts are for one company and which are shared by all companies for example a common expense list . Step by step Add an account 1. Open Chart of Accounts and select Add Account . 2. Choose the Parent Account : for an account, its group or sub group; for a new group, the class for example 100000 Assets ; for a sub group, its group. 3. Enter the Name and choose the Type : Asset, Liability, Equity, Revenue, Cost of Goods Sold or Operating Expense. The normal balance debit or credit follows from the type. 4. Choose Postable if journal lines may post to it; leave it unticked for a header. 5. Choose the Company , or Shared All Companies . 6. For a heading, you can set the Cash Flow Category Operating, Investing, Financing . The accounts beneath it follow it in the Cash Flow Statement. 7. For an Assets group or sub group, set Cash / Bank : Cash makes its accounts cash accounts, and Bank makes them bank accounts. Cash and Bank Transactions, PDCs, Fixed Assets and payroll then offer them as the cash or bank side. 110000 Cash / Petty Cash and 120000 Bank Accounts come marked. Changing the mark changes it for every account under the group. For a heading or an account, choose what its lines need: Cost center , Profit center and Project , each Required , Optional or Not used . Blank follows the heading above; the hint says what applies now. With nothing set, Expense, Revenue and Cost of Sales accounts need a cost center, as before. A Not used field is greyed out on the entry screens and never posted. A cash or bank account itself one that takes postings can have a Currency , for example a USD bank account: its Cash and Bank Transactions are then in USD. It can't change once the account has postings; open a new account for another currency. 8. Select Save Account . The code is given automatically: the next free number under the parent. Find accounts Filter by company, type, status, or "Postable only". Choosing a company shows its own accounts and the shared ones; "Shared All Companies " shows only shared ones. The list opens on Active accounts; choose All Statuses or Inactive in the status filter to see retired ones. Move an account to another head Change its Parent Account and save. The account gets the next code under the new head, only if it has never been used . Once anything has posted to it or a document refers to it , the move is refused: create a new account under the right head, move the balance with a journal entry journal entries.html , and set the old one Inactive. Renumber an account within its group To give an account another code in the same group or sub group for example 110001 to 110025, to match your old chart , select the Renumber button on its row. The free codes of the group are shown; enter the one you want and the reason. Everything that shows the old code shows the new one from then on: posted entries, drafts, invoices, cheques, recurring templates, orders and requisitions. The account keeps its balance and history. Its old code stays in its details Edit: "formerly 110001", with the date , so an old printout can still be traced, and the change is logged. You can't renumber an account into another group, because its history would move to another part of the financial statements. Headings are not renumbered. Accounts to fix If an account takes postings but is not under a group it has no parent, sits straight under a class, or has a heading's code , an Accounts to fix box lists it above the chart. Edit each one and choose its group as the parent. If it has already been used, it can't move: create a new account under the group, move the balance with a journal entry journal entries.html , and set the old one Inactive. Retire an account Set its Status to Inactive . It stays in the history and reports but can't be used in new entries. It then leaves the list, which shows Active accounts unless you change the status filter. An account's default tax code On a postable account, Default tax code optional is the tax code tax configuration.html a Vendor Invoice vendor invoice.html 's direct lines on the account take, for example a blocked code on an entertainment account. A line may still be given another code with Vendor Invoice's change tax code right. Good to know Some accounts are control accounts , kept by their own screens: each vendor's payables and each customer's receivables account in the Vendor and Customer masters , and each item's inventory account. Lines on a party's control account must name the party; see Paying and allocating payments and allocation.html . Cash and bank accounts are the accounts under a group marked Cash or Bank , whatever their code. Cash and Bank Transactions offers only those as the cash or bank side. Period Closing's default Retained Earnings account is the first account under 320000 Retained Earnings, until you choose another.

pages.title: Currency Configuration
pages.summary: The currencies list, the default currency the books are kept in, exchange rates by date and the Exchange Gain / Loss account.
pages.text: Currency Configuration What it is for Sets the default functional currency the books are kept in. Every journal entry, invoice and report is in that currency; entry screens show it in their read only Currency field. Before you start Only users with Currency Configuration rights normally Admin can change it. Set it once, before the first entry. Step by step 1. Open Currency Configuration and select Add Currency . 2. Enter the Code ISO 4217 , for example AED or USD , the Name and the Symbol . 3. Tick Set as default functional currency for the one the books use. 4. Save. Only one active currency is the default. Exchange rates A vendor or customer can be in a foreign currency its Default Currency in Vendor or Customer Master . Its invoices, payments and statement are then in that currency, at a rate you enter here. 1. Select Rates on the foreign currency's row. 2. Enter the date the rate takes effect and the rate: how much of the default currency one unit is for example 1 USD = 3.6725 AED . 3. Add . The rate applies from that date until a later one. Rates are only added, never edited: a document keeps the rate it was made with. To correct a rate, enter the right one from the same date; the later entry wins from then on. Rates from the sheet Rates can also come from a Google Sheet, which the firm keeps for every client. It uses GOOGLEFINANCE, so its rates are indicative and can be up to 20 minutes late. Nothing applies until you confirm it: 1. Under Rates from the sheet , click Get rates from the sheet . 2. For each currency you see: the sheet's rate; the last rate you entered and its date; the change. A rate more than 5% from the last one is marked and left unticked: tick it only if it is right for example after a devaluation . 3. Choose the date the rates take effect today by default , tick the ones to use, and click Apply the ticked rates . An applied rate is an ordinary rate, its note From the sheet . Apply is refused if the sheet's rate changed after you read it: get the rates again. A currency the sheet lacks, or a cell still calculating, is listed and left out. Exchange Gain / Loss When a foreign bill is paid at a rate other than its own, the difference in the default currency is a realized exchange gain or loss. Choose, for each company, the Exchange Gain / Loss account a Revenue or Expense account and the cost center its lines take when the payment line has none. A payment that settles a foreign bill at another rate is refused until it is set. Rights Write : add currencies, set the default, choose the Exchange Gain / Loss account. Rates : enter exchange rates, and get and apply them from the sheet Roles & Permissions, Currency Configuration . Good to know The books, the Trial Balance and every report stay in the default currency. Foreign amounts are kept beside the default currency amounts on each line. Rates are typed in, or read from the firm's sheet when you click; the sheet is never read on its own, and nothing applies without your Apply. Changing the default later does not convert anything already posted, so choose it before going live.

pages.title: Opening Balances
pages.summary: Bring a company's position on its go-live date into the ERP: the trial balance, opening stock and unpaid invoices.
pages.text: Opening Balances What it is for When a company starts using the ERP, its balances from the old system are brought in once, dated the day before go live go live 1 January → opening date 31 December . Three kinds, each on its own tab: GL : the trial balance every account except the control accounts ; Stock : quantity and unit cost per item and warehouse; Open Invoices : each vendor's and customer's unpaid documents and advances, so statements, aging and payment allocation work from day one. Before you start Opening Balances is for Admin users. An Equity account for Opening Balance Clearing for example "Opening Balance Clearing" . Items, warehouses, vendors and customers already set up Master Data Import helps . Step by step 1. Choose the Company , set the Opening date and the Opening Balance Clearing account , and select Save setup . 2. On a tab, select Copy headers or Copy headers with a sample row , paste into Excel, fill it in, then copy the rows and paste them into the grid. 3. Select Check . Every problem is listed by row and column an unknown account, a missing batch number, a document entered twice… . Fix them in Excel and paste again. 4. When the check is clean, select Post . All rows post together, or none. 5. Repeat for the other tabs. When all three are in, the Clearing balance shown must be zero : then the GL, stock and open invoices agree. What each tab takes Tab Columns required ones marked on the screen GL Account, Debit, Credit, Description, Cost Center, Profit Center Stock Item, Warehouse, Quantity, Unit Cost, Batch No, Expiry Date Open Invoices Party Type, Party, Document Type Invoice / Advance , Document No, Document Date, Due Date, Amount, Description What happens in the books All dated on the opening date: GL : one entry with your rows; the difference goes to Clearing. Stock : the stock comes in at your cost Dr each item's Inventory account, Cr Clearing . Open Invoices : one entry per party on its control account, each document kept with its own number, date and due date, so payments can be allocated against it like any invoice. Inventory, Trade Payables and Trade Receivables are not entered on the GL tab: their balances come from the Stock and Open Invoices tabs. Corrections A posted batch can be Reversed as a whole Admin, any time , then a corrected one posted. A reversal is refused when a document in it has already been paid, or the stock has since been used; undo those first. Good to know Amounts are in the default currency; quantities in the item's base unit. For a vendor or customer in a foreign currency , the Amount is in its currency and Rate optional gives the rate; blank, the rate on the document date from Currency Configuration. The entry is in the default currency at that rate. Dates in the paste may be dd/mm/yyyy or yyyy mm dd; at most 2,000 rows. The opening date and clearing account are fixed while any batch is posted.

pages.title: Journal Entries (JV)
pages.summary: Record any accounting entry by debits and credits: accruals, corrections, reclassifications, write-offs.
pages.text: Journal Entry Processing (JV) What it is for A Journal Voucher JV records an entry directly in the accounts: debit and credit lines that must balance. Use it for anything no other screen records: accruals and provisions, corrections, reclassifications, discounts and write offs, settling an advance against a bill. For money in or out of a cash or bank account, use Cash and Bank Transactions cash and bank.html instead. Before you start The accounts exist and are postable see Chart of Accounts chart of accounts.html . Expense, revenue and cost of sales lines need a cost center . Step by step 1. Open Journal Entry Processing JV and select New Journal Entry . 2. Fill the header: Company , Entry Date , Description , and if used the Reference , Division , Branch , Cost Center and Profit Center the header's cost and profit centers are the lines' defaults . 3. Add the lines: Account Code , Debit or Credit , description, and the cost or profit center where needed. You can paste lines from Excel into the grid. 4. A line on a vendor's or customer's account needs the Vendor / Customer , and its Allocate see Paying and allocating payments and allocation.html . 5. Check that total debits equal total credits. 6. Save as Draft to finish later, or Post Entry . Where an approval is set up, the entry goes for approval instead see Approvals approvals.html . Correcting a posted entry A posted entry can't be edited. Select Reverse Entry , choose the reversal date in an open month : a mirror entry is posted and the original stays on record. Then enter the right one. The description of a posted entry can still be corrected with the edit button next to it. Entries posted by other screens invoices, cheques, payroll, opening balances… are reversed from their own screen; the JV screen refuses them and says where. What happens in the books When posted, each line is recorded on its account and date, and the entry gets its numbers: the JV number per company and year and the Txn Ref the finance reference, shared with other finance documents . It shows in the General Ledger general ledger.html , Trial Balance trial balance.html and the statements. Rights Viewing, drafting and posting are separate rights Roles & Permissions . Rematch lets a user change which bills a posted entry's vendor or customer lines settle, without reversing it Re match references , see Paying and allocating payments and allocation.html . Approval, where set up, is by the approvers in Approval Configuration. Questions and mistakes "…is closed for …" : the entry date is in a closed month. Use a date in an open month, or ask for the month to be reopened Period Closing period closing.html . A cost center is required : expense, revenue and cost of sales lines need one. A line marked in red needs a cost center, profit center or project: its account requires it Chart of Accounts . The Project column shows once the company has a project. A party is required : a line on a vendor's payables or customer's receivables account must name that party, and only that party's own account may be used. "… is invoiced in USD: enter the line's USD amount beside its amount" : the party is in a foreign currency. Its line shows a USD amount beside the debit or credit: enter both. The allocation is in USD, and a difference from the bills' rates posts as an exchange gain or loss, as in Cash and Bank cash and bank.html . Those exchange lines are worked out again each time the entry is saved, so the grid doesn't show them; the GL Impact does.

pages.title: Cash and Bank Transactions (CBT)
pages.summary: Payments, receipts and transfers through cash and bank accounts, with vendor and customer allocation.
pages.text: Cash and Bank Transactions (CBT) What it is for Records every movement through a cash or bank account: Type Use it for Bank Payment / Cash Payment Paying a vendor, an expense, an advance Bank Receipt / Cash Receipt Money received from a customer or anyone else Fund Transfer Moving money between your own cash and bank accounts Before you start Your cash and bank accounts: the accounts under a group marked Cash or Bank in the Chart of Accounts chart of accounts.html 110000 Cash / Petty Cash and 120000 Bank Accounts come marked . Vendors and customers set up with their payables / receivables account. Step by step 1. Open Cash and Bank Transactions and select New Transaction . 2. Choose the Transaction Type , then the Company . 3. Choose the Ledger Account : the cash or bank account the money moves through for a Fund Transfer, the account it moves from . 4. Fill the date, description and reference. 5. Add the other side, one line per account: who it was Paid To , Received From , or for a transfer the account it goes To ; the Amount , a description, and a cost center where the account needs one. 6. For a vendor or customer, pick the Vendor / Customer and Allocate the amount to their bills see Paying and allocating payments and allocation.html . 7. Save as Draft , or post. Where an approval applies to that transaction type, it goes for approval instead. 8. Print gives the payment or receipt voucher. A vendor or customer in a foreign currency For a party invoiced in a foreign currency say USD , the line shows a USD amount beside the Amount : enter both, what the bank moved in the default currency and what it is in USD. The allocation is in USD. If the bills were at another rate, the ERP adds the exchange difference lines itself: one on the party's account and one on the company's Exchange Gain / Loss account Currency Configuration currencies.html . A bank account in a foreign currency If the Ledger Account is in a foreign currency its Currency in the Chart of Accounts chart of accounts.html , say USD , the screen shows Currency and rate : the rate on the date, which you may change with a reason. Enter the amounts in USD; the books take them in the default currency at that rate. A vendor or customer paid from it must be in USD too or in no currency of its own for lines without a party . A Fund Transfer from a default currency account into a USD account asks for the USD amount the account receives: the rate is what the two amounts make. A transfer between two different foreign currencies goes through a default currency account for now. Cash from a sales rep A sales rep's cash their receipts from the Employee Portal, see Sales reps sales rep portal.html waits on the company's Rep Cash Clearing account, against the rep. To take it: a Cash Receipt into the cash account, a line on the Rep Cash Clearing account, then choose the Sales rep shown as Sales rep — AK Ahmed Khan and Allocate the amount to the rep's receipts RC AK 000001 … . The rep's balance in the portal drops by itself, and each receipt shows Handed over . A short count is simply a smaller amount: what is left stays on the rep. Correcting a posted transaction Select Reverse Entry and choose the date: a mirror entry is posted and any bills it settled become unpaid again. Then enter it correctly. From an invoice's Linked documents , Create next opens a new one here already started for the invoice's open amount. See Working with screens working with screens.html linked documents and create next . What happens in the books Payment: Dr each line's account e.g. the vendor's payables , Cr the cash or bank account. Receipt: Dr the cash or bank account, Cr each line's account e.g. the customer's receivables . Fund Transfer: Dr the account it goes to, Cr the account it comes from. The entry gets a Voucher No. per type and company, and a Txn Ref . Rights As Journal Entries: view, draft and post are separate rights. Approval can be set per transaction type Approval Configuration . Questions and mistakes "…is closed for …" : the date is in a closed month Period Closing period closing.html . The allocation doesn't fit : a bill was paid by someone else in the meantime; the ERP checks again when posting. Open Allocate and choose again. A posted payment settles the wrong bill : open it and select Re match references the rematch right : choose the right bill without reversing the payment Paying and allocating payments and allocation.html . "… is invoiced in USD: enter the line's USD amount beside its amount" : fill the USD amount on that line. A line marked in red needs a cost center, profit center or project: its account requires it. The Project column shows once the company has a project. A draft made by "Portal: …" is a sales rep's cash collection from the Employee Portal Sales reps sales rep portal.html : check it and post it. Post dated cheques are not entered here: use Post dated Cheques post dated cheques.html .

pages.title: Paying and allocating against bills
pages.summary: How payments, receipts and adjustments are tied to a vendor or customer and matched to their invoices.
pages.text: Why it matters Each vendor and customer has its own account payables or receivables . To know what is still owed per invoice — for statements, aging and due dates — every amount on those accounts names its party and says what it settles. The two kinds of allocation Kind Meaning Example Against Ref Settles bills or invoices already posted or an earlier advance Paying invoice VI 1021 in full and VI 1034 in part New Ref Opens a new item for the party An advance paid before any bill exists A line's allocations add up to its amount. A line with no allocation chosen is kept as a New Ref for its full amount. Step by step: a payment against bills 1. In Cash and Bank Transactions cash and bank.html Bank Payment , add a line on the vendor's payables account and choose the Vendor / Customer . 2. Select Allocate . The vendor's open items show with their date, due date and Outstanding amount. 3. Enter the amount against each bill, or select Oldest first to fill from the oldest. The New Ref line under the list shows what is left, kept open for later for example an advance ; All as New Ref settles nothing now. Done keeps it. 4. Post. The bills show as Paid or Partly paid in the invoice lists. Settling an advance against a bill Use a Journal Entry journal entries.html with two lines on the vendor's account: one Against the bill, one Against the advance, same amount on opposite sides. Fixing a wrong pick: Re match A posted payment or receipt that settles the wrong bill or should have left part as an advance doesn't need to be reversed. Open the posted entry in Cash and Bank Transactions cash and bank.html or Journal Entries journal entries.html and select Re match references : 1. Allocate… on the vendor or customer line shows the party's open items, counting this entry's own allocation back in, so the bill it settled now shows its full outstanding again. 2. Choose again, and select Done : for example All as New Ref , then the right bill; or All as New Ref alone, to make the payment an advance. The New Ref line shows what stays open. 3. Select Save re match and give the reason. Only which items the entry settles changes: its amounts, accounts and date stay, so the books don't change. The bills' outstanding, the statements and the aging follow at once. It works in a closed month too, because nothing is posted. Each re match is kept with the entry who, when, the reason, and what it settled before and after . Cancel re match leaves the entry as it was. Re match has its own right, rematch , on Journal Entries and on Cash and Bank Roles & Permissions . An advance New Ref that another entry has already set against a bill can't become smaller than what that entry uses; re match that entry first. Entries posted by other modules post dated cheques, returns, retail sales, opening balances keep their matching in their own module. Discounts and write offs A JV: the party line Against the invoice, and the discount or write off amount on the expense or income account on the other line. Good to know A party line may only use that party's own payables or receivables account. A Sales rep is a party too: their line is on the company's Rep Cash Clearing account, and their open items are their receipts see Cash and Bank cash and bank.html cash from a sales rep . When posting, the ERP checks again that each bill still has enough outstanding; if someone else paid it meanwhile, the post is refused with the reason. An invoice can't be reversed while payments are allocated to it: reverse those payments first. Due dates are the invoice date plus the party's payment terms. For a party in a foreign currency , bills, payments and allocations are all in its currency. A bill is settled when its foreign amount is; any difference in the default currency is posted as an exchange gain or loss Cash and Bank cash and bank.html . Cash and Bank, Journal Entries and Post dated Cheques all take the foreign amount.

pages.title: Recurring Journal Entries
pages.summary: Entries that repeat on a schedule — rent, depreciation-like accruals, prepaid expenses spread over months.
pages.text: Recurring Journal Entries What it is for A recurring entry is a template that posts the same journal on a schedule: monthly rent accrual, a prepaid insurance spread over twelve months, a monthly provision. Each run becomes a normal journal entry dated on its run date. Before you start The accounts exist, as for a Journal Entry journal entries.html . Step by step 1. Open Recurring Journal Entries and select New Recurring Entry . 2. Fill the header and lines as on a JV. The description may include {MONTH} , {DATE} or {YEAR} for example "Rent {MONTH}" posts "Rent Oct 2026" . 3. Choose the Amounts : Fixed : the lines' amounts on every run; Spread a total : a total shared equally over the runs; Spread by service period : a total over a service period from, to , each month charged for its days; for example 12,000 for 16 Sep – 15 Sep gives 500, then 1,000 a month, then 500. 4. Choose the Schedule : monthly on a day a day past the month's end runs on its last day , monthly at month end, weekly on a weekday, or monthly on the first … last weekday; every 1, 2, 3… months or weeks 3 = quarterly, 12 = yearly . 5. Choose when it Ends : on an end date, or after a number of runs. 6. Check the preview: every run date with its amount. 7. Save , then activate it with approval, where set up . Posting the runs Runs are posted by a person, not automatically. When a run's date comes, Recurring Journal Entries Due to Post appears in Home tasks. Select Post Due Runs on the list for all, or on one entry . Missed past dates are posted each with its own date. Run by run On an entry's run list: Skip a date no posting that month ; Reverse a posted run a mirror entry; then Post again or Skip ; a run that failed an account made inactive, a closed month… shows the reason; fix it and post again. Changing an active entry Pause , edit, then resume it goes through approval again where set up . End stops it for good. What happens in the books Each run posts a journal entry numbered RJV … dated on its run date, seen in the General Ledger like any JV. Reverse runs from this screen, not from the JV screen. Rights As Journal Entries; activating, pausing, ending, skipping and reversing need the post right.

pages.title: Post-dated Cheques (PDC Received and Issued)
pages.summary: Cheques dated in the future: received from customers or issued to vendors, then cleared, bounced or cancelled.
pages.text: PDC Received PDC Issued What it is for A post dated cheque PDC settles invoices on the day you receive or issue it, but the money only moves on the cheque date. These screens keep the cheque in a clearing account until then. PDC Received : cheques from customers. PDC Issued : cheques you give vendors. Before you start In Company Master , the company's PDC Received Clearing and PDC Issued Clearing accounts. The customer or vendor set up with its receivables / payables account. Step by step Record a cheque, or a set of cheques 1. Select New PDC . 2. Choose the Company and the customer or vendor. 3. Enter the date received or issued and a description. Issued: choose your bank account the cheques are drawn on. 4. Under Cheques , enter each cheque's Cheque No. , Cheque Date and amount. Received: type the Drawee Bank the customer's bank for each. Add cheque adds a line. Monthly series adds more cheques after the last one, a month apart, with the next numbers and the same amount and bank. For example, cheque 000101 dated 31/01/2026 with two more gives 000102 on 28/02/2026 and 000103 on 31/03/2026. Change any line afterwards. 5. Allocate the total to the invoices it pays or Oldest first . Anything not allocated stays as an advance. With several cheques, the earliest cheque settles the oldest invoice, and so on. 5. If it replaces a bounced cheque, choose it in Replaces . 6. Save Draft , or Post or submit for approval, where set up . Each cheque after posting A set of cheques is posted as one entry with one number. Each cheque gets that number with 01, 02 … the earliest cheque first and its own GL entry. From then on each cheque is cleared, bounced or cancelled on its own. Open any of them to see the whole entry: every cheque with its status for example "1 of 3 cleared" ; select another to work on it. Print gives one receipt for the entry, listing all its cheques. Clear it on its date When the cheque date comes, the cheque appears in Home tasks under Post dated Cheques Due to Clear and in the Due to clear view. If a Treasury team is set for the company in Approval Configuration approval configuration.html , only the team sees it on Home, and a few days before its date 3 to start ; a cheque not yet due shows its date in amber, an overdue one in red. Select Clear to Bank with the clearing date not before the cheque date ; for a received cheque, choose the bank account it was deposited into. Several cheques can be cleared together with Clear Selected . Cheques a sales rep collected A cheque a rep collected in the Employee Portal see Sales reps sales rep portal.html is posted at once, with its receipt, and marked with the rep in the list. When the rep hands it over, open it and choose Received from the rep or tick several and Received from the rep above the list : no money moves, and the cheque can then be cleared. Clear to Bank and Bounced wait until then. If it doesn't go through Bounced : the bank returned it. Enter the date and reason; the invoices it settled are open again only what this cheque settled, for one of a set . Cancel Cheque : withdrawn before clearing, same effect. Undo Clearing : a clearing entered by mistake goes back to Pending. Bank charges for a bounced cheque are entered separately a JV or CBT . From an invoice's Linked documents , Create next opens a new one here already started for the invoice's open amount. See Working with screens working with screens.html linked documents and create next . What happens in the books Event PDC Received PDC Issued Post Dr PDC Received Clearing · Cr the customer Dr the vendor · Cr PDC Issued Clearing Clear Dr Bank · Cr PDC Received Clearing Dr PDC Issued Clearing · Cr Bank Bounce / cancel The post entry reversed: the party owes again The same The invoices show "Paid PDC pending " until the cheque clears. Statements of account list pending cheques separately. Rights As Cash and Bank Transactions: view, draft, and post which also covers clear, bounce, cancel and undo . Questions and mistakes Refused as a duplicate : the same cheque number and bank, and party is already recorded and not bounced or cancelled. Can't clear before the cheque date. Can't bounce : an advance the cheque created has since been used against an invoice; undo that first. "… is invoiced in USD: enter the cheque's USD amount too" : the party is in a foreign currency. Enter the cheque's Amount what the bank pays and its USD amount : the cheque settles bills in USD, and a difference from their rates posts as an exchange gain or loss. A bounce or cancellation undoes both. A draft made by "Portal: …" is a cheque a sales rep collected in the Employee Portal, with its photo in the supporting documents Sales reps sales rep portal.html : check it and post it.

pages.title: Statements of Account (Vendor and Customer)
pages.summary: Everything posted with one vendor or customer over a period, the running balance, what is still open, and pending cheques.
pages.text: Vendor Statement of Account (SOA) Customer Statement of Account (SOA) What it is for A statement of account SOA shows one vendor's or customer's history for a period: opening balance, every invoice, payment, receipt, note and adjustment with a running balance, the closing balance, and what is still open by document. Step by step 1. Open Vendor Statement of Account or Customer Statement of Account . 2. Choose the Company and the vendor or customer. 3. Choose From and To , and select Run . 4. Read it: the rows with debit, credit and balance; open items : each unpaid document with its due date, days overdue and outstanding amount, and the aging of what is open; pending PDCs : cheques not yet cleared at the end date; a check against the party's account in the General Ledger. 5. Select a document number to open it Back returns to the statement . 6. Print for the party, or CSV to open it in Excel. Good to know The open items always add up to the closing balance, because every amount on a party's account is allocated see Paying and allocating payments and allocation.html . The print leaves out the internal GL check. For a party in a foreign currency the statement is in its currency it says so under the payment terms , with a Balance column in the default currency beside it. The open items show each document's rate and its outstanding amount in the default currency. Exchange differences are in the default currency balance only. The GL check uses the default currency balance.

pages.title: Customer and Vendor Aging
pages.summary: How old each party's open balance is, in buckets, with advances and pending cheques shown apart.
pages.text: Customer Aging Vendor Aging What it is for Shows, for every customer or vendor with something open, how much is not yet due and how much is overdue by 1–30, 31–60, 61–90 or more than 90 days — to chase collections or plan payments. Step by step 1. Open Customer Aging or Vendor Aging . 2. Choose the Company and the As at date today by default . 3. Choose Age by : Days overdue from the due date : Not yet due, 1–30, 31–60, 61–90, over 90; Days since the invoice date : 0–30, 31–60, 61–90, 91–120, over 120. 4. Select Run . 5. Each row is one party: payment terms, the buckets, Owed , Unapplied credits advances and credits not matched to an invoice , Net balance , and Pending PDCs shown, not deducted . 6. Select a row to see its open documents; SOA opens the party's statement statements of account.html . 7. Copy to Excel or Print . Good to know The report checks its total against the parties' accounts in the General Ledger at that date and says whether they agree. Each party's figures agree with its statement of account at the same date. A party in a foreign currency is shown in the default currency, each document at its own rate, so the totals and the GL check add up; its net balance in its own currency is shown under the net balance for example USD 200.00 . Open the row to see each document's rate.

pages.title: General Ledger Report (Ledger and Listing)
pages.summary: Every line posted to an account, with its opening, running and closing balance; or a plain listing across several accounts.
pages.text: General Ledger Reports (GL) What it is for The General Ledger shows what was posted to an account and why. It has two views: Ledger : one account over a period, with opening balance, every line, running balance and closing balance; Listing several accounts : the lines of any accounts you pick, by date, without balances, with debit and credit totals. Step by step Ledger 1. Open General Ledger Reports GL , keep Ledger selected. 2. Choose the Company , the Account , From and To . 3. If needed, narrow by Division , Branch , Cost Center or Profit Center . 4. Tick Include Draft entries to see drafts as well marked DRAFT; their figures may still change . 5. Select Run Report . Listing 1. Select Listing several accounts . 2. Pick an account and select Add or press Enter ; repeat for more. A header account brings in every account beneath it. Remove one with its ×. 3. Choose the dates and filters, and run it. From a line to its source Select the Txn Ref to see the whole journal GL Impact : every line with account, cost center, debit and credit. From there, Copy to Excel or Open source document the invoice, payment, cheque… that posted it . Select the Voucher No. to open the source document directly. Copy Table and Print follow the view on screen. Good to know Project filters the lines by project; No project shows those without one see also the Project Report project report.html . The Ledger of a cash or bank account in a foreign currency for example USD shows a Balance USD column beside the balance, and each line's USD amount under its debit or credit. Reports such as the Trial Balance trial balance.html open the General Ledger for an account when you select it; Back returns. A listing shows at most 20,000 lines; narrow the dates or accounts if asked.

pages.title: Trial Balance
pages.summary: Every account's opening balance, movements and closing balance for a period, with drill-down to the ledger.
pages.text: Trial Balance (TB) What it is for The Trial Balance lists every account with its Opening balance, the period's Transactions debit and credit and its Closing balance. Total debits equal total credits; it is the first check that the books are complete. Step by step 1. Open Trial Balance TB . 2. Choose the Company and the period. From starts at the beginning of the company's financial year; change it as needed. 3. Narrow by Division , Branch , Cost Center or Profit Center if needed. 4. Select Run Report . 5. Select an account to open its General Ledger general ledger.html for the same period; Back returns here. 6. Copy Table to Excel, or Print . Before year end closing After a financial year is closed, its income and expense accounts are zeroed into Retained Earnings by the year end closing entry. Tick Before year end closing to see the closed year's income and expense balances as they were. Good to know Anything dated before From is in the Opening column. Project shows only the lines of one project or those with No project . See Period Closing period closing.html for the year end entry.

pages.title: Profit and Loss, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow
pages.summary: The three financial statements, with drill-down from each figure to the ledger.
pages.text: Profit and Loss Statement (P&L) Balance Sheet (BS) Cash Flow Statement (CFS) What it is for Statement Shows Period Profit and Loss P&L Revenue, cost of sales and expenses, and the profit From – To Balance Sheet Assets, liabilities and equity As of a date Cash Flow Statement Cash in and out, by Operating, Investing and Financing From – To Step by step 1. Open the statement and choose the Company . 2. Choose the period From and To or, for the Balance Sheet, the As Of date. 3. Narrow by Division , Branch , Cost Center or Profit Center if needed for example a P&L per cost center . 4. Select Run Report . 5. Select an account line to open its General Ledger general ledger.html ; Back returns. 6. Copy Table to Excel, or Print . Good to know The P&L leaves out the year end closing entry, so a closed year still shows its profit. The Cash Flow is by the direct method: each cash or bank movement is classed by the account on its other side. That account's Cash Flow Category comes from its header in the Chart of Accounts chart of accounts.html ; without one it counts as Operating. The figures follow the posted entries only; drafts are not included. The P&L can be filtered by Project or No project ; the Project Report project report.html shows every project side by side.

pages.title: Project Report
pages.summary: Each project's income, costs and result for a period, by account.
pages.text: Project Report What it is for The Project Report shows, for a company and a period, what each project earned and cost: its Income revenue accounts , its Costs expense and cost of sales accounts and the Result . Lines posted without a project show under No project . Before you start The projects exist in Organizational Units org units.html type Project . Entries carry their project: a Project on the journal or cash and bank line, or on the invoice. Step by step 1. Open Project Report and choose the Company . 2. Choose From and To , and a Project or All, or No project . 3. Select Run Report . Each project shows its customer, dates, status, income, costs and result. 4. Select a project to see its accounts. 5. Copy to Excel, or Print . Good to know Only income and cost accounts count: a project's receivable or bank lines are not part of its result. The GL Report general ledger.html , Trial Balance trial balance.html and Profit and Loss can also be filtered by project. For example: project PRJ 1 Tower A invoiced 500.00 and spent 100.00 on site labour, a result of 400.00.

pages.title: Period Closing (month-end and year-end)
pages.summary: Check and close each month so nothing more can be posted into it, and close the financial year into Retained Earnings.
pages.text: Period Closing What it is for Closing a month locks it: nothing can be posted, reversed or approved with a date in it, so reported figures stay as reported. Closing the year moves its profit or loss into Retained Earnings. Before you start On the Setup tab, per company: the Financial year : January – December or April – March fixed after the first year end ; the Retained Earnings account ; the checklist : each item set to Block the month can't close while it finds something , Warn listed, but the month can still close or Off not checked .
