Checklist item Drafts dated in the period, not posted Documents waiting for approval Recurring journals due and not posted Depreciation not run for the month Payroll for the month not posted Post dated cheques matured and not cleared Deliveries posted, not invoiced Customer Aging agrees with the receivables accounts Vendor Aging agrees with the payables accounts Stock value agrees with the inventory accounts The Trial Balance balances Two lists of your own, also each Block, Warn or Off: Accounts that must be zero at month end : clearing and suspense accounts, such as a GRN clearing or payroll clearing account. A balance on the account at the month's end is a finding, with the amount. Steps to tick before closing : your own steps, such as "Bank reconciliation done" or "Petty cash counted". Until the step is ticked for the month, it is a finding. Step by step Close a month 1. Open Period Closing , choose the Company ; the Months grid shows the year. 2. On the first open month, run the Checklist : each item shows what it found, with the documents. 3. Tick the steps you have done. Anyone who can close months can tick them; the Log keeps who ticked and when, and the closed month keeps its ticked steps. If the month is reopened, its steps are ticked again before it closes again. 4. Fix what blocks, then select Close . Months close in order. Reopen a month Select Reopen on it and give the reason. The months after it reopen too; the ones before stay closed. Every close and reopen is in the Log . Close the year When all twelve months are closed and the previous year is closed , select Close the year . After you confirm, a Year End Closing entry YEC … dated on the last day of the year moves every income, cost of sales and expense balance, by account and cost center, to Retained Earnings. Reopen the year with a reason reverses that entry; a month of a closed year can't be reopened until its year is. What happens in the books Closing a month posts nothing. Closing the year posts the Year End Closing entry. The P&L financial statements.html leaves it out; the Trial Balance trial balance.html can show the year before it. Payroll and depreciation in a closed month Reversing or redoing a payroll run, a settlement, a loan or depreciation of a closed month offers to date it in the first open month instead; the entry records the original date. Rights Viewing and the checklist: Period Closing access. Closing and reopening are separate rights by default Admin and Finance Manager . Questions and mistakes "yyyy mm is closed for …" on any screen: the document's date is in a closed month. Use an open month's date, or reopen the month here. Can't close : a blocking checklist item found something; open it to see the documents.

pages.title: Tax Configuration
pages.summary: Each company's sales tax: UAE VAT, India GST or a tax of its own, with its components, accounts and tax codes rated by date.
pages.text: Tax Configuration What it is for Tax Configuration says how a company charges sales tax: its regime UAE VAT, India GST, or a tax of its own , the components the tax is charged as, each posted to its own accounts, and its tax codes standard, zero rated, exempt … , each with its rate from a date. Items name their tax code in Item Master item master.html ; customers and vendors their registration type, state or emirate, and tax number in Customer Master customer master.html and Vendor Master vendor master.html . Customer Invoices customer invoice.html , Vendor Invoices vendor invoice.html and their returns take their tax from here, line by line, and so do Retail Sales retail sales.html and asset sales in Fixed Asset Retirement fixed asset retirement.html . Sales Orders sales order.html , their Proforma Invoices and Purchase Orders purchase order.html show an estimate of the tax. The tax reports are in Tax Reports tax reports.html ; India's B2CL limit GSTR 1's invoice value above which an inter state sale to an unregistered buyer is listed on its own, ₹1,00,000 by default is set here. Before you start The tax accounts exist in the Chart of Accounts chart of accounts.html : for UAE VAT an output and an input VAT account; for India GST one of each for CGST, SGST or UTGST , IGST and, if used, cess. You need Tax Configuration's setup right to change it Admin by default ; access lets you look. Step by step 1. Open Tax Configuration and choose the company. 2. With nothing set up yet, start from UAE VAT , India GST or an own regime . The preset fills in its components and tax codes; nothing is saved until you save. 3. Choose the company's emirate UAE VAT or its GST state , the first two digits of its GSTIN India GST . 4. Rounding : per rate on the whole document UAE VAT's default or per line India GST's . 5. For each component , choose its output tax account sales and input tax account purchases . 6. Check the tax codes : their name, what kind each is, the recoverable % of input tax 100 unless part of it can't be reclaimed, the rest then being part of the cost , and Active . 7. Save . When a rate changes Add a rate to the code with the date it applies from Add a rate . A document takes the rate valid on its own date, so documents before the change keep the old rate. Don't change the old row. India GST Within the company's state a rate is charged as CGST and SGST in a union territory such as Chandigarh, UTGST , half each; to another state, an SEZ or abroad, as IGST . Whether a sale is within the state comes from the customer's state the place of supply . A code can carry a cess % as well. The preset holds the rates as revised from 22/09/2025 5%, 18% and 40%, with 0.25% and 3% for stones and gold . The earlier 12% and 28% are kept, inactive, for documents dated before. Check the codes against your own items, and adjust them as needed. A tax of your own For another country's tax, start from an own regime : name up to six components for example STATE and CITY , then give each code's rate as a % per component 6% STATE and 1.5% CITY make 7.5% . Rights access shows the configuration; setup changes it. A tax code that documents have used can't be removed make it inactive , and the regime of a company whose documents use its codes can't change. Questions and mistakes "Choose the company's GST state" : India GST needs it, to tell CGST + SGST from IGST. "… belongs to another company" : a component's account must be the company's own or shared by all companies. "Tax code … is used by documents" : untick Active instead. For example: Example Trading LLC Dubai starts from UAE VAT, picks Dubai, Output VAT 2200 and Input VAT 1400, and saves; its SR code charges 5% from 01/01/2018. Related pages Item Master item master.html · Customer Master customer master.html · Vendor Master vendor master.html · Chart of Accounts chart of accounts.html

pages.title: Tax Reports
pages.summary: A company's tax for a period from its posted documents: the tax summary, UAE VAT 201, and India's GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B, ready to copy to Excel.
pages.text: Tax Reports What it is for Tax Reports works out a company's tax for a period, ready for the person who files the return. It reads the documents posted with tax line by line see Tax Configuration tax configuration.html : Customer Invoices customer invoice.html and Sales Returns sales return.html ; Retail Sales retail sales.html and their returns; asset sales in Fixed Asset Retirement fixed asset retirement.html ; Vendor Invoices vendor invoice.html and Purchase Returns purchase return.html . The reports are: Tax summary , for any regime: sales and purchases by tax code and by component, with the part reclaimed, the part that went to cost, and reverse charge. VAT 201 , for UAE VAT: the boxes of the FTA's return. GSTR 1 and GSTR 3B , for India GST: GSTR 1 as the sheets of the GST offline tool, and GSTR 3B's tables. Filing stays outside: you enter the figures on the FTA or GST portal yourself. Before you start The company has a Tax Configuration tax configuration.html . Customers and vendors have their registration type, state or emirate, and tax number GSTIN or TRN in Customer Master customer master.html and Vendor Master vendor master.html . The reports use what is there when you run them. For India, items have their HSN or SAC code in Item Master item master.html , for GSTR 1's HSN summary. Step by step 1. Choose the Company . The Report list shows the reports its regime has. 2. Choose the period: From and To , or This month , Last month or Last quarter . 3. Click Run . 4. Click a figure's row to see the documents behind it. 5. Click Copy on a table and paste it into Excel. GSTR 1's sheets copy with the GST offline tool's headings, dates for example 05 Oct 2026 and units, ready to paste into the tool's template. How the figures are counted Dates. A document counts on its own date. A Sales Return, Purchase Return or retail return counts minus. Reversals. A reversed document stays in its own period. Its reversal counts minus on the reversal's date. Currency. Amounts are in the company's base currency, at each document's exchange rate. Documents with one tax %. A document posted before line tax, with one tax % for the whole document, is not counted. The screen says how many such documents fall in the period, with their tax and numbers, so you can add them from the old figures. VAT 201: boxes 1a–1g are standard rated sales by emirate, the place of supply. A counter sale, or an asset sold to the bank, counts in the company's own emirate; box 6 is goods from an overseas vendor under reverse charge, and box 3 is the rest of reverse charge; box 9 is standard rated purchases with the VAT you can reclaim; box 14 is the tax due less the tax reclaimed; adjustments bad debt relief, corrections, box 7 are made on the FTA portal. GSTR 1: B2B: registered buyers and SEZs; B2CL: inter state invoices to unregistered buyers above the B2CL limit in Tax Configuration ₹1,00,000 by default ; B2CS: the rest, by state and rate, Retail Sales included. A credit note to a consumer reduces it; EXP: exports, with or without IGST; CDNR and CDNUR: credit notes; nil rated, exempt and non GST supplies, the HSN summary B2B and B2C apart , and the documents issued by series. GSTR 3B: 4 A is the full input tax of each purchase, and 4 B reverses the part the tax code doesn't let you reclaim; 6.1 shows each component's tax payable, the net credit, and reverse charge, which is paid in cash. Setting off one tax's credit against another is done on the portal. Rights access runs the reports, for the companies you can open. Admin, Finance Manager and Accountant have it by default. Questions and mistakes "This company has no Tax Configuration" : set its tax up first. A figure looks wrong. Open its documents and check the party's registration type and state, and each line's tax code. Documents are "not in this report" : they were posted with one tax % before line tax. For example: Example Trading LLC Sharjah runs VAT 201 for October. Box 1b shows Dubai's sales of 1,400.00 with VAT of 70.00, from invoices CI 1 and CI 2 . Related pages Tax Configuration tax configuration.html · Customer Invoice customer invoice.html · Vendor Invoice vendor invoice.html · Retail Sales retail sales.html

pages.title: Procurement Setup
pages.summary: Set the company buying defaults that govern requisitions, orders and receiving.
pages.text: Procurement Setup What it is for Procurement Setup defines the standard company buying rules. It keeps the same defaults across all purchases, so requisitions, orders and receipts follow the same purchasing controls. Before you start The company is already created and the relevant accounts exist in the Chart of Accounts. The purchasing team has agreed which approvals and controls the company uses. The item and supplier setup is ready before the workflow is released to users. Step by step 1. Open Procurement Setup and select the company. 2. Review the default approval and receiving rules used for the company. 3. Confirm the purchase defaults that should apply to new requisitions and orders. 4. Save the setup and test a simple requisition or order to confirm the rules are active. What happens in the books Procurement Setup does not post entries by itself. It determines the defaults the ERP uses when the actual requisition, purchase order, GRN and invoice are created. Rights This screen is normally restricted to the ERP administrator or the procurement setup role. Questions and mistakes If the expected rules are not showing, the company or role setup may be incomplete. If the flow is blocked at the next step, check whether the setup was saved and the company is selected correctly.

pages.title: Vendor Master
pages.summary: Maintain the supplier record used in requisitions, purchase orders, GRNs and supplier bills.
pages.text: Vendor Master Data What it is for Vendor Master keeps every supplier record used by the buying process. The ERP reuses this record when a purchase is raised, received and finally invoiced. Before you start The company and the vendor account structure are set up in the ERP. The vendor's tax and company details are known. If the company wants supplier controls, the approval and payment rules are already defined. Step by step 1. Open Vendor Master and choose the company. 2. Add or update the vendor's basic details: name, address, contact and tax information. 3. Complete the trade details needed for purchasing and payment processing. 4. Save the vendor and test a PO or GRN using that vendor. Tax registration Beside the Tax Registration No. a UAE TRN, an Indian GSTIN … , choose the vendor's tax registration type registered, unregistered, composition, SEZ, overseas, consumer and its state / emirate . In India the state decides the place of supply: within the company's own state GST is charged as CGST and SGST, otherwise as IGST see Tax Configuration tax configuration.html . A registered party in India needs its GSTIN, which is checked: its first two digits must be the state chosen, and its last character must agree with the rest. A UAE TRN of a registered party is 15 digits starting 100. The City and PIN / postal code go on the vendor's e invoices. India's e invoice needs both; an Indian PIN code is 6 digits, not starting with 0. A vendor in a foreign currency Set Default Currency to the vendor's currency for example USD and its invoices, payments and statement are in it, at the rates in Currency Configuration currencies.html . Leave it on the company default for a local vendor. Once the vendor has invoices or payments, its currency can't change: create a new vendor for another currency. What happens in the books Vendor Master stores the supplier identity used by the purchase flow. The actual accounting impact appears later when the supplier bill and any related payments are posted. Rights Typically a procurement or master data role can maintain vendors. Full setup rights are usually limited to admin or finance support users. Questions and mistakes If a vendor is missing from the dropdown, the record may not be saved or the company filter may be wrong. If a supplier bill cannot be matched, check that the company and vendor on the PO and GRN are the same supplier record.

pages.title: Purchase Requisition
pages.summary: Ask for a purchase before the order is raised, with approval and tracking for the requested item or service.
pages.text: Purchase Requisition What it is for Purchase Requisition is the request for stock or a service before a vendor order is issued. It creates a formal record and allows approval before purchasing begins. Before you start The company, vendor and item setup are in place. The approval workflow is configured for requisitions. The requestor knows the quantity, description and date needed. Step by step 1. Open Purchase Requisition and choose the company. 2. Enter the request header and the requested lines. 3. Add the quantities, units and descriptions needed. To enter many lines at once, fill them in Excel: Copy Table copies the lines with their headings Category, Description, Quantity, Unit, Cost Ctr , also on an empty grid, so you have the columns to fill. Select the rows in Excel, copy them, and click Paste from Excel or click into a cell of the grid and press Ctrl+V ; the headings row is skipped. If a row has a category that isn't found, a quantity that isn't a number above zero or a cost centre that isn't found, nothing is pasted and the message names the rows to fix. 4. Submit the requisition. Where approval is configured, it goes to the approver. 5. Once approved, create the purchase order from the approved request. From a saved document, Create next starts the next step and Linked documents shows the documents before and after it. See Working with screens working with screens.html linked documents and create next . What happens in the books A requisition does not post to the general ledger. It is a control and approval document, not an accounting entry. Rights Users need approval and draft rights for the requisition workflow, and approvers need the approval role for the module. Questions and mistakes The requisition can be rejected or returned for correction. If the item is not available for selection, check the item master and the company assignment.

pages.title: Inventory Purchase Requisition
pages.summary: Raise a stock requisition for inventory needs before the warehouse buys and receives the goods.
pages.text: Inventory Purchase Requisition What it is for Inventory Purchase Requisition is the stock specific version of a purchase request. It is used when a warehouse or department asks for a stock purchase before a supplier order is raised. Before you start The stock item and warehouse details are known. The item is in Item Master and is active for purchase. The workflow and any approval steps are ready. Step by step 1. Open Inventory Purchase Requisition and choose the company. 2. Add the item, quantity and warehouse or location. 3. Add any notes for the purchasing team. To enter many lines at once, fill them in Excel: Copy Table copies the lines with their headings Item Code, Warehouse, Description, UOM, Quantity, Cost Ctr , also on an empty grid. Copy the rows from Excel and click Paste from Excel or click into a cell of the grid and press Ctrl+V ; the headings row is skipped. If a row has an item code, warehouse, unit or cost centre that isn't found, or a quantity that isn't a number above zero, nothing is pasted and the message names the rows to fix. 4. Submit it for approval when required. 5. When approved, it can be used to raise the purchase order. From a saved document, Create next starts the next step and Linked documents shows the documents before and after it. See Working with screens working with screens.html linked documents and create next . What happens in the books This requisition still does not post a financial entry; it is a control document that prepares a future stock purchase. Rights Requestors need access and draft rights. Approvers need the approval right for the requisition. Questions and mistakes If a warehouse does not appear, the warehouse or company setup may be incomplete. If a stock item is not available, check its item master and item status.

pages.title: Purchase Order
pages.summary: Issue the approved order to the supplier and keep the commitment, delivery and receiving status aligned.
pages.text: Purchase Order What it is for Purchase Order is the supplier commitment that follows an approved requisition or a direct vendor request. It formalises the quantity, price and delivery plan for the goods or service. Before you start The supplier has a valid vendor record. The item and quantity are approved. The order date and delivery target are known. Step by step 1. Open Purchase Order and choose the company. 2. Select the supplier and the items or services to order. 3. Confirm the quantity, prices, delivery date and warehouse. 4. Submit it. If configured, it goes for approval before the order is active. 5. Track the order until receipt or closure. Estimated tax For a company with a Tax Configuration tax configuration.html , the grid shows below its total the Estimated tax and the Total with tax : what the invoice will charge, by each item's tax code at its rate on the order date and, under India GST, CGST + SGST or IGST by the vendor's state. It is an estimate: nothing is posted, and the invoice works out the tax again when it is made. Each line's components are rounded as the invoice rounds them. An item without a tax code is named in place of the estimate: give it one in Item Master item master.html . From a saved document, Create next starts the next step and Linked documents shows the documents before and after it. See Working with screens working with screens.html linked documents and create next . What happens in the books A purchase order itself is usually a commitment document, not a stock or ledger entry. The real accounting effect happens when the goods are received and the invoice is posted. Rights Users need access and draft rights to create orders, and approval rights if approval is enabled. Questions and mistakes If quantities or suppliers do not line up, check the approved requisition or vendor record. If the order cannot be completed, the company or item configuration may not be valid for the selected supplier.

pages.title: Goods Receipt Note (GRN)
pages.summary: Receive the purchased goods into stock and match the supplier receipt against the order.
pages.text: Goods Receipt (GRN) What it is for Goods Receipt Note GRN records what actually arrived from the vendor. This is where the ERP turns a purchase order into real stock on hand. Before you start The purchase order is approved and open. The item, supplier and warehouse are valid. The company has the right stock account and GRN settings. Step by step 1. Open Goods Receipt Note and select the company. 2. Choose the supplier and the approved purchase order. 3. Enter the received quantities, item by item. 4. Check the warehouse, unit and any batch or expiry details. 5. Post the GRN. The stock ledger and item availability update with the receipt. From a saved document, Create next starts the next step and Linked documents shows the documents before and after it. See Working with screens working with screens.html linked documents and create next . What happens in the books The GRN updates the stock ledger and the item value basis. It is also the document the supplier invoice will match against later. Rights Users need access and post rights to receive stock against a purchase order. Questions and mistakes If the item does not appear, check the PO or item master. If the receipt is refused, the supplier or order details may be mismatched. A closed month will reject a GRN date in the closed period. "select a Cost Center" : a non stock category posts to an account that needs one its rule in the Chart of Accounts chart of accounts.html .

pages.title: Vendor Invoice
pages.summary: Match the supplier bill to the received GRNs and post the payable amount to the company books.
pages.text: Vendor Invoice Processing What it is for Vendor Invoice records the supplier bill against the received goods or services. It checks the invoice against the GRNs and records the payables impact in the ledger. Before you start The GRN is posted and the purchase is received. The supplier and company match the PO and GRN. The invoice amount and quantities are ready for verification. Step by step 1. Open Vendor Invoice and choose the company. 2. Choose the supplier and the relevant GRNs to match. 3. Review the items, quantities and amounts before posting. 4. Save or post the vendor invoice once the supplier bill is confirmed. 5. Review the payables impact in the ledger. Tax by line Where the company has a Tax Configuration tax configuration.html , the invoice has no Tax % . Each line is taxed by its own tax code : a GRN's goods take their item's code Item Master ; a direct line, and a GRN's non stock line, takes its account's default code, from the Chart of Accounts chart of accounts.html ; the rate is the code's rate on the invoice date, and the discount is spread over the lines before tax; under India GST, a vendor in the company's own state charges CGST + SGST, and one in another state or abroad IGST. The state comes from the vendor's State / emirate Vendor Master . The Tax box lists each line: its code, rate, components, the tax, and the part reclaimed . To give a line another code, choose it there. That needs Vendor Invoice's change tax code right Admin and Finance Manager by default . Tax that can't be reclaimed. A tax code says how much of its input tax is recoverable 100 % unless part of it is blocked . Posting debits the part reclaimed to each component's input account. The rest is part of the cost: on a direct line , it goes to the line's own account; on goods received , it is added to their cost in the warehouse they came into, which raises their average cost. If none of the goods is left in stock there, it goes to the item's consumption account. Reverse charge a code of that kind : the vendor charges no tax and the total doesn't include it. The company accounts for the tax itself: it is credited to the component's output account, and its recoverable part is reclaimed as input tax, so the two cancel out. Reversing the invoice reverses all of it, the goods' added cost included. For example: Sample Supplies , in the company's state, bills 10 sheets received at 20.00 each GST 18 % and freight of 100.00 GST 5 % . CGST and SGST are 20.50 each and the total is 341.00. With a code that reclaims nothing, the 36.00 of tax on the sheets goes into their cost instead. A vendor in a foreign currency If the vendor's Default Currency Vendor Master is not the default currency, its invoice is in that currency: the screen shows Currency and rate : the rate on the invoice date, from Currency Configuration currencies.html ; you may type another rate, with a reason; the total shows in the vendor's currency, with its value in the default currency beside it; for now such an invoice takes direct lines only : GRNs stay in the default currency. The books are in the default currency, at the invoice's rate; each line keeps its foreign amount too. A reversal uses the invoice's own rate. Project Once the company has projects, the invoice has a Project field: every line the invoice posts carries it, for the Project Report project report.html . From a saved document, Create next starts the next step and Linked documents shows the documents before and after it. See Working with screens working with screens.html linked documents and create next . What happens in the books The vendor invoice records the supplier liability and clears the matched purchase value from the receiving side. This is the main point where the purchase becomes a balance in accounts payable. Rights Users need access and post rights for supplier invoice processing; approval may be required in some companies. Questions and mistakes If the invoice is refused, the supplier, GRN or company may not match. "No exchange rate for USD on or before …" : enter a rate in Currency Configuration → Rates. If the amount does not tie to the GRN, recheck the posted receipt and the supplier bill.

pages.title: Purchase Return / Debit Note
pages.summary: Return goods to the supplier, reverse the stock and capture the debit note for the vendor return.
pages.text: Purchase Return / Debit Note What it is for Purchase Return / Debit Note records stock being sent back to a supplier. It reverses the value and quantity taken from the original purchase and keeps a record for the supplier's debit note. Before you start The original invoice or GRN is still valid for return. The supplier and company details are known. The item quantity being returned is confirmed and the reason is recorded. Step by step 1. Open Purchase Return / Debit Note and choose the company. 2. Select the vendor and the source invoice or GRN line. 3. Enter the return quantity and the reason for the return. 4. Post the return. The system updates the stock and the supplier return ledger. 5. Review the resulting value and any variance entries created by the return. What happens in the books The return reduces stock and may create a variance if the return value differs from the original cost. The supplier balance also reflects the return or debit note. An invoice taxed by line When the invoice was taxed by line Tax Configuration tax configuration.html , each returned line takes its share of its invoice line's tax, by quantity, at the codes and rates the invoice used: the input tax the invoice reclaimed is credited back; under reverse charge, the output tax is debited back; tax that couldn't be reclaimed was in the goods' cost. The goods leave at that cost, so the vendor's refund of it goes with the return's variance. The Tax line shows by line . Rights Users need access and post rights for returns, plus approval rights if the company uses approval on returns. Questions and mistakes A return can be refused if the source invoice or GRN line is already fully returned or reversed. If the return value differs from the expected value, review the original vendor invoice and the stock cost used in the receipt.

pages.title: Item Master
pages.summary: Maintain the master item record used by purchase, stock movement, valuations and stock reports.
pages.text: Item Master What it is for Item Master is the core record for every stocked item. It defines the item, its stock rules, and the company data that allows purchasing and inventory movement. Before you start The item category and units are already set. The company has its stock accounts and item coding rules. The item is active for the relevant warehouse and company. Step by step 1. Open Item Master and choose the company. 2. Add or edit the item record: code, description, unit and category. The Sub Category list shows the category's shared sub categories and those of the item's company; New… beside it opens Item Sub Category to add one save the item first: you come back to Item Master and open it again . 3. Set the stock and cost details required by the company. 4. Save the item and check it appears in the stock routines. Your own item code The system gives each item its item code from its category for example RM 000123 . You can also give an item a User code of your own in the item form, for example BRG 6204 or A100 : up to 30 letters, digits, / or . starting with a letter or digit . Everywhere else in the ERP, the item shows its user code in place of the item code: lists, reports, prints and what you copy to Excel. Hold the mouse over it to see the item code. Where you enter an item on a line, you can type either code, and the search list shows and finds both. Once chosen, the box shows the item code with the user code beneath it. A pasted line can have the user code in its first column. A user code is unique in your organisation ignoring capitals , and can't be another item's item code. Leave it blank for none. Item Master itself shows both: the item code, with the user code beneath it. Search finds either. The item code stays what the ERP stores on every document, so adding or changing a user code changes nothing already entered. Its tax Tax code is the code a document line takes for the item, from the company's Tax Configuration tax configuration.html for example SR for standard rated VAT, GST18 for 18% GST . HSN / SAC is India's classification: an HSN code for goods 4, 6 or 8 digits , a SAC code for services 6 digits starting 99 . Both are optional where the company has no use for them. Categories of your own Besides the five categories Raw Material, Semi Finished Good, Finished Good, Consumable, Scrap , you can add your own, for example Spare Parts . Select New category… under Category in the item form, then enter: the name ; the code prefix 2 to 6 letters or digits, for example SP . Its items get codes with it and their own running number: SP 000001, SP 000002 and so on. The format can be changed in Numbering numbering.html , like the five; which of the five it behaves like . That decides what a BOM, a Job Order and Production allow Spare Parts behaving like Consumable can be a BOM component, but is not produced ; whether it is shared by all companies or one company's. Anyone who can open Item Master can add one. The new category then appears in the Category list and the filter, after the five. Sub categories can sit under it Item Sub Category item sub category.html . An item's category, the five or your own, can't change after the item is made, because its code depends on it. Existing items stay where they are. What happens in the books The item master does not create a ledger entry itself. It provides the item definition that the purchase, stock issue, transfer and valuation processes use. Rights Users need write access for item setup. Read access is often broader than write access. Questions and mistakes If an item does not appear on a stock screen, check the item status and the company assignment. If the item has no cost basis, the system will not post a trade movement correctly.

pages.title: Units of Measure
pages.summary: Configure active unit codes and quantity precision; alternate-unit conversions are maintained per item.
pages.text: Unit of Measure What it is for Units of Measure UOM maintains the available unit codes and whether quantities in each unit must be whole numbers or may use decimals. It does not define a global conversion table; an item's alternate unit and conversion factor are maintained on that item in Item Master. Before you start The business has agreed its unit codes/names and quantity precision rules. Item owners know the base UOM and any alternate UOM conversion factor required for each item. Default units PCS, KG, LTR, MTR, BOX are seeded when needed; review the existing list before adding duplicates. Step by step 1. Open UOM and review each code, name, decimal rule, and status. 2. Add a unit with a unique code up to 8 characters , name, and Allow decimals setting. If decimals are allowed, set the permitted decimal places from 0 to 6. 3. Keep units inactive rather than deleting a unit that may be referenced by existing items or transactions. 4. In Item Master, assign the item's base UOM and optional alternate UOM/conversion factor. Test a transaction in both units and verify the stored base quantity. What happens in the books UOM setup does not post a journal. Its precision rules validate entered quantities; the item's conversion factor converts an allowed alternate UOM into its base quantity for stock movements and reports. Rights UOM access controls viewing; the UOM write right controls adding, editing, and activating/deactivating units. Item Master has separate rights for assigning units and item specific conversion factors. Questions and mistakes Fractional quantity is rejected: the selected unit is configured as whole numbers only; either enter a whole quantity or ask the setup owner to confirm whether decimals should be allowed. Alternate unit is unavailable: configure it on the item in Item Master; UOM itself does not create item conversions. Converted stock quantity is wrong: verify the item's conversion factor and whether the transaction entered base or alternate units. Unit is inactive: reactivate it only if new transactions should use it; historical documents keep their recorded quantities. Related pages Item Master item master.html · Stock Adjustment stock adjustment.html · Warehouse Movement warehouse movement.html

pages.title: Item Sub Category
pages.summary: Group items by type or line so stock and reporting match the company’s product structure.
pages.text: Item Sub-Category What it is for Item Sub Category adds a second classification beneath Item Master's fixed item category. For example, a Raw Material item may be classified as Metals or Packaging. Each sub category belongs to exactly one parent category: one of the five, or a category of your own added in Item Master item master.html ; this is an item list organization/filtering aid, not a new ledger or stock category. Before you start Agree the sub category names and which fixed parent category each belongs to: Raw Material, Semi Finished Good, Finished Good, Consumable, or Scrap. Check the existing list before adding a similar label. A sub category is either shared by all companies or belongs to one company , as items do. Step by step 1. Open Item Sub Category and review the list by name, parent category, and status. 2. Select Add Sub Category , choose the parent category one of the five or one of your own and the company or All Companies — shared , enter a name, and save. From Item Master, New… beside Sub Category opens this form with the item's category and company already chosen; Back to Item Master returns the item is opened again . 3. To change an existing classification, edit its name, parent category, or status. Reactivate an inactive sub category if it should be selectable again. 4. Open Item Master and assign the sub category to the appropriate items. Item Master offers the sub categories of the item's parent category that are shared or belong to the item's company; a shared item can use only shared ones. What happens in the books Sub Categories do not affect item code generation, stock quantity, costing, or GL posting. The fixed parent Item Category continues to control the item's stock/production class; the sub category provides additional classification for item setup and filtering. Rights ITEMSUBCAT access allows viewing; write allows adding, editing, deactivating, and reactivating sub categories. Item Master has its own rights for assigning a sub category to an item. Questions and mistakes Parent category is wrong: edit the sub category and choose one of the five fixed parent categories; a sub category cannot belong to multiple parents. Sub category is missing on an item: confirm it is Active and its parent matches the item's fixed Category. Changing it does not change an item code or ledger: that is expected; sub category is for organization/filtering, not item numbering or accounting. A sub category is missing for a company: it belongs to another company; make one for this company or a shared one. Can't make a sub category one company's: an item of another company, or a shared item, already uses it. Related pages Item Master item master.html · Stock Availability stock availability.html · Stock Valuation stock valuation.html

pages.title: Material Issue
pages.summary: Issue stock to a department or process and keep the warehouse quantity and cost records aligned.
pages.text: Material Issue (MI) What it is for Material Issue records a stock Issue or a deliberate Return to a warehouse. It captures where material went/returned, the quantity, reason, and accounting dimensions; it does not automatically relieve components when a Production Entry is posted. Before you start The company, active item, warehouse, UOM, quantity, description, and date are known. For an Issue, sufficient stock is available at that warehouse; the posting cost comes from current average cost. For a Return, verify that the stock is physically coming back. Return cost is the current average cost, not necessarily the cost of the original issue. The item's Consumption account is valid; the transaction date is in an open period and approvals are configured if needed. Step by step 1. Open Material Issue and select Issue or Return deliberately. Issue is the default; Return is not inferred from a positive quantity. 2. Set the company, date, description, optional reference, and division/branch/cost/profit center dimensions. 3. Add lines by scanning/searching or pasting from Excel. Choose item, warehouse, description, base or configured alternate UOM, positive quantity, and optional batch reference and line cost/profit center. 4. Review the available quantity reference. Save as Draft if more review is needed; post only after checking direction and line detail. 5. If approval is configured, posting submits the document; stock and GL change only after approval. Rejected documents can be edited and resubmitted. 6. After posting, inspect GL Impact and the Stock Ledger. Reverse an incorrect posted entry through the reversal action with a reason; don't edit posted lines. What happens in the books An Issue moves stock Out at current average cost, debits the item's Consumption account, and credits Inventory. A Return moves stock In at current average cost, debits Inventory, and credits Consumption. The line movement and GL are posted together; a reversal mirrors the original entry. Rights MATERIALISSUE access controls viewing, draft creates/edits/deletes Draft or Rejected documents, and post submits/posts, approves/rejects where assigned, and reverses. Approval Configuration and company access apply. Questions and mistakes Issue cannot post: check available quantity at that warehouse, active reservations, item status, and the selected UOM conversion. Return cannot post: returns add stock but still need a positive current average cost; if stock is zero, establish a cost basis with GRN or Production first. Return amount differs from original issue: returns use current WAC and are not linked to a specific original issue. Batch number is blank: Material Issue stores a batch reference but does not require one even for batch tracked items; follow the company's traceability procedure. Approval is pending: no inventory or GL posting occurs until approval completes. Consumption account is invalid: correct the item account in Item Master before posting. Related pages Production production.html · Stock Availability stock availability.html · Stock Ledger stock ledger.html · Approvals approvals.html

pages.title: Warehouse Movement
pages.summary: Transfer stock between warehouses or locations while keeping the ledger and balances in step.
pages.text: Warehouse Movement What it is for Warehouse Movement transfers an item quantity between two different warehouse/rack locations within the same company. It preserves total company inventory value while changing the physical location, and can be gated by Approval Configuration. Before you start Both source and destination are active Warehouse or Rack organizational units usable by the company. The item is active and the source location has enough quantity; the item has a valid UOM and batch details where required. The date is in an open period and the transfer's reason/description is documented. Approval Configuration is set if the business requires approval for this movement. Step by step 1. Open Warehouse Movement and create a document. Select company, date, description, optional reference, and default reporting dimensions. 2. Add lines by scanning/searching or pasting from Excel. For each line choose item, From Location, To Location, line description, UOM, positive quantity, batch when required, and cost/profit center as needed. 3. Confirm the source and destination differ, the entered unit is the item's base or configured alternate UOM, and the source has enough stock. The available quantity is a reference while editing; the server validates at posting. 4. Save as Draft or post. If approval is configured, posting submits the document and no stock moves until approval; a rejected movement can be corrected and resubmitted. 5. After posting, verify source and destination quantities in Stock Ledger/Availability. If incorrect, use Reverse Movement with a reason rather than editing posted lines. What happens in the books No GL journal is created: moving stock within the company does not change its total value. The stock ledger records an Out at the source and an In at the destination at the same resolved cost; batch and receipt age information move with the stock. Newly available stock at the destination can be allocated to open Sales Order shortfalls. Rights WAREHOUSEMOVEMENT access controls viewing, draft creates/edits/deletes Draft documents, and post submits/posts, approves/rejects where assigned, and reverses. Company access applies. Questions and mistakes Movement is refused: check source quantity, valid Warehouse/Rack locations, different From/To, UOM conversion, positive quantity, description, and required batch number. No quantity moved while pending approval: this is expected; approval gates the stock ledger update. No GL voucher appears: this transaction has no GL entry by design; inspect stock ledger balances at both locations. Destination Sales Order reservation changed: inbound stock may automatically fill open order shortfalls at the destination. Movement date is closed: use an open date or follow Period Closing; do not bypass the period lock. Related pages Organizational Units org units.html · Stock Ledger stock ledger.html · Stock Availability stock availability.html · Approvals approvals.html

pages.title: Stock Adjustment
pages.summary: Correct the item quantity or value after a count, loss, damage or writing off stock.
pages.text: Stock Adjustment What it is for Stock Adjustment is a controlled inventory transaction for increasing or decreasing a warehouse/rack quantity when a documented correction is needed. It carries a date, reason, reference, dimensions, and lines, and may require approval before stock and accounting are changed. Before you start The physical count, damage/loss, write off, or other adjustment reason is documented. The item and warehouse/rack are active for the company; batch tracked items have batch details. The item's Write off account or configured Consumption fallback is valid for posting. The transaction date is in an open period, and Approval Configuration is set if this adjustment type is gated. Step by step 1. Open Stock Adjustment and create a document. Select company, date, description, optional reference, and default division/branch/cost/profit center dimensions. 2. Add each item line by scanning/searching or pasting from Excel. Choose Increase or Decrease , warehouse/rack, line description, UOM, quantity, batch number where required, and line cost/profit center where applicable. 3. Check the available quantity shown for reference. An increase inherits the item's current average cost; it cannot establish an initial cost when the item has zero current stock. Use a GRN or Production Entry to establish cost first. 4. Save as Draft if needed. Post the document when the lines, direction, quantities, batches, date, reference, and reason have been checked. 5. If Approval Configuration applies, posting submits it for approval. The approver approves or rejects; rejected documents can be corrected and posted again. Approved/postable documents update inventory and GL. 6. Review the posted document's GL Impact and the Stock Ledger. Reverse a posted adjustment through its reversal action with a reason; do not edit its posted lines. What happens in the books An Increase adds inventory at current average cost; a Decrease removes it at the applicable stock cost. The inventory account is offset against the item's Write off account or Consumption account fallback : decreases debit the offset and credit inventory; increases debit inventory and credit the offset. The document creates stock transactions and a GL journal. An increase can also allocate newly available stock to open Sales Order shortfalls. Rights STOCKADJUSTMENT access controls viewing, draft creates/edits/deletes Draft or Rejected documents, and post submits/posts, approves/rejects where assigned, and reverses. Approval levels are controlled through Approval Configuration; company access applies. Questions and mistakes Increase cannot post: this item has zero stock and therefore no average cost to inherit; establish stock/cost with GRN or Production first. Line is rejected: confirm the item, warehouse/rack, UOM conversion, positive quantity, required description, and batch number for batch tracked items. Decrease exceeds stock: check the item's available quantity in that warehouse and any other posted movements before changing the count. Approval is pending: no stock or GL change occurs until approval. GL offset account is missing: set the item's Write off or Consumption account in Item Master. Period is closed: use an allowed open date or follow the Period Closing reopen/adjustment process; do not backdate into a locked month. Related pages Item Master item master.html · Stock Ledger stock ledger.html · Physical Count physical count.html · Goods Receipt Note goods receipt note.html · Approvals approvals.html

pages.title: Physical Count
pages.summary: Count stock physically and post the difference between the counted quantity and the system balance.
pages.text: Physical / Cycle Count What it is for Physical / Cycle Count records counted quantities for item/location lines, compares them with system quantities, and posts only the resulting differences. It supports Draft, approval, posting, GL review, and reversal like other stock documents. Before you start Define the count date, company, warehouse/rack coverage, and responsible count team. Confirm the item, UOM, batch number where applicable, and item Write off account. The date is in an open period; Approval Configuration is set if variances require approval. Decide whether the count sheet is a full snapshot or only selected items; system quantity is shown as a reference, not a replacement for the physical count. Step by step 1. Create a Physical Count and select company, date, description, optional reference, and dimensions. 2. Add each counted item/location line by scanning/searching or pasting from Excel. Enter Counted Quantity , not the variance. Use the correct UOM and batch details. 3. Compare the count with the displayed System Qty and review the calculated variance for every line. Exact match lines are allowed and have no GL impact. 4. Save as Draft, investigate material differences, then post. If approval is configured, the count remains pending and does not adjust stock until approved; rejected counts can be edited and resubmitted. 5. After posting, review the GL Impact and Stock Ledger. Reverse a posted count with a reason if it was wrong. A reversal entry cannot itself be reversed; enter a new count to correct that situation. What happens in the books For each line, the system converts counted quantity to the item's base UOM and compares it with the ledger quantity. A positive variance increases inventory; a negative variance decreases it. The offset is the item's Write off account or Consumption fallback . Exact matches post no GL entry. Increases inherit current average cost; decreases remove stock at its current cost. The count records the movement and GL impact for audit. Rights PHYSICALCOUNT access controls viewing, draft creates/edits/deletes Draft or Rejected counts, and post submits/posts, approves/rejects where assigned, and reverses. Company access and period locks apply. Questions and mistakes Variance looks wrong: confirm whether the entered value is counted quantity, the unit conversion, warehouse/rack, and batch. No GL entry for the count: if all counted quantities match system quantities, no variance journal is created. Decrease is refused: check available quantity and other stock movements dated in the same period. Increase is refused at zero stock: current average cost is required; establish cost with a GRN or Production before increasing through a count. A reversal of a reversal is unavailable: this is intentional; post a new count to correct stock instead. Count cannot post: check date/period lock, approval status, item account mapping, and whether the document is Draft or Rejected. Related pages Stock Adjustment stock adjustment.html · Stock Ledger stock ledger.html · Stock Valuation stock valuation.html · Approvals approvals.html

pages.title: Stock Availability
pages.summary: Review sellable item on-hand, active sales-order reservations, and free quantity by warehouse.
pages.text: Stock Availability What it is for Stock Availability is a current snapshot for sellable items: it shows on hand quantity, active Sales Order reservations, and free quantity for each item/warehouse. Free is on hand minus reserved; it does not include purchase orders that are on order. Before you start Items are active and have a price on a Price List; the report uses the same sellable item definition as Sales Order. Stock transactions and active reservations are up to date for the company. The user has Stock Availability report access and company access. Step by step 1. Open Stock Availability and select the company. The report loads item/warehouse rows with nonzero on hand or reserved quantity. 2. Search by item code/name, optionally filter to a warehouse, or tick Negative free stock only to find rows where active reservations exceed on hand. 3. Compare On Hand, Reserved, and Free. Use the item/warehouse row that matches the sales promise or warehouse request; a company wide total can hide a shortage at a particular location. 4. To see what a Reserved quantity is for, select it: the Sales Orders reserving it show under the row number, date, customer and quantity, oldest first . Select an order's number to open it, if you may open Sales Orders. Select the quantity again to close the list. 5. For a replenishment view that includes approved purchase orders, use Reorder / Low Stock Report reorder.html instead. What happens in the books This report is read only. It does not reserve stock, change stock, or post a journal. On Hand comes from the stock ledger; Reserved comes from active Sales Order reservations. Rights STOCKAVAILABILITY access controls viewing, limited to companies the user can access. Questions and mistakes Item is missing: it must be active and priced on at least one Price List; raw material/WIP without a selling price is intentionally excluded. Free is negative: select the Reserved quantity to see which Sales Orders hold it, and review them and actual on hand by warehouse; this view does not include inbound purchase orders. Company total seems sufficient but order can't ship: reservations and stock are location specific; compare the order's warehouse row. A posted receipt/issue is absent: verify the source transaction's company, warehouse, status, and stock ledger update. Related pages Reorder / Low Stock Report reorder.html · Stock Ledger stock ledger.html · Sales Order sales order.html

pages.title: Stock Ledger
pages.summary: Review the full stock movement history for items and warehouses, by date and transaction.
pages.text: Stock Ledger Report What it is for Stock Ledger Report is the transaction level history for one item at one warehouse or rack. It shows the opening balance before the selected range, every movement in the range, the running quantity/value, and the closing balance. Before you start The item, specific warehouse/rack, and date range are known. The source transactions are posted. Reversed transactions appear according to their reversal history and the report's date range. The user has Stock Ledger access to the selected company. Step by step 1. Select company, item, Warehouse/Rack, and From/To dates. This report requires one item and one location; use Stock Valuation for a multi item snapshot. 2. Run the report. Review the opening quantity/value, movement date, voucher number/type, description, In/Out quantities, running balance, average cost, and value. 3. Click a voucher number to open the source transaction. Use Back to return to this report with the same filters. 4. Copy the table or print it for reconciliation. Compare the closing balance with the stock ledger/valuation at the end of the range. An InputTaxCost row changes the value, not the quantity. It is input tax that couldn't be reclaimed on a Vendor Invoice vendor invoice.html , added to the goods' cost, and the average cost rises with it. What happens in the books The report is read only. It does not change stock or create a journal. Transactions before the From date are folded into the opening balance; transactions after To are excluded. Movement order follows the order that originally determined moving average cost, rather than sorting solely by the displayed date. Rights STOCKLEDGER access controls viewing, subject to company access. Opening a source voucher additionally requires rights to that transaction module. Questions and mistakes Transaction is missing: check company, item, selected warehouse/rack, From/To range, and Posted status. Opening balance is not zero: it includes all qualifying stock history before the selected start date. Destination warehouse misses an inbound transfer: confirm the movement posted and that the destination location, not the source, is selected. Balance differs from a date sorted reconstruction: moving average cost follows original posting order; later dated entries posted earlier can affect WAC sequence. Voucher cannot open: the report can show movement history while the source module still enforces its own access and company permissions. Related pages Stock Availability stock availability.html · Stock Valuation stock valuation.html · Inventory Aging inventory aging.html · Warehouse Movement warehouse movement.html

pages.title: Stock Valuation
pages.summary: Report current on-hand quantity and moving-average value by item/location, with optional rack consolidation.
pages.text: Stock Valuation Report What it is for Stock Valuation Report is a current snapshot of posted stock ledger quantity and value by item/location. It derives average cost as total ledger value divided by quantity and can show warehouse totals with their racks combined or each rack separately. Before you start Stock movements have been posted and the stock ledger reflects the period you intend to review. The user has Stock Valuation access to the selected company. Know whether reviewers need rack level locations or warehouse totals. Step by step 1. Open Stock Valuation Report and choose the company. 2. Optionally filter by one of the fixed item categories. 3. Leave Combine racks into their warehouse checked for one total per warehouse, including its racks. Uncheck it to list each warehouse and rack separately. 4. Run the report. Review quantity, average cost, and total value by item and location, then check the grand total. Copy the table to Excel or print it for reconciliation. 5. Compare differences with the Stock Ledger and source receipts/issues/adjustments. This report is not date filtered; use Inventory Aging inventory aging.html for an as at date. What happens in the books The report is read only and does not post. It sums the current stock ledger quantities and values; Average Cost is Total Value ÷ Quantity. It is a current snapshot, not a historical as at valuation. Rights STOCKVALUATION access controls viewing, subject to company access. Questions and mistakes Rack value appears under the warehouse: rack consolidation is enabled; turn it off for separate location rows. Quantity/value is zero or absent: zero quantity locations are omitted. Check the current stock ledger and posted transactions. Average cost differs from a receipt price: it is a moving average ledger cost, not the most recent purchase price. Need historical value: this report shows the current ledger; use Inventory Aging for an as at date and its age buckets. Related pages Stock Ledger stock ledger.html · Inventory Aging inventory aging.html · Inventory Valuation List inventory valuation.html

pages.title: Inventory Valuation
pages.summary: Maintain effective-dated production unit costs for Job Order finished and semi-finished items; this is not the stock-on-hand valuation report.
pages.text: Inventory Valuation List What it is for Despite its name, Inventory Valuation List is not the report of stock on hand. It is the production standard cost list: an effective dated unit cost for each Finished Good or Semi Finished Good that has an active Bill of Materials and can be selected for a Job Order. Production uses the cost effective on the production date when it values output. Keep historical cost rows rather than overwriting a cost that applied to an earlier production period. For warehouse quantities and inventory value, use Stock Valuation stock valuation.html instead. Before you start The company, eligible item, approved cost basis, and effective date are known. The item is active and eligible for a Job Order: a Finished Good or Semi Finished Good with an active BOM. The user has Inventory Valuation access to view the list and write permission to maintain costs. Step by step Add a production unit cost 1. Open Inventory Valuation List and select the company. The list and item picker are company specific. 2. Select the eligible production item, enter a unit cost greater than zero, and choose the date from which that cost applies. 3. Add the cost and confirm that the new row appears with the intended item, amount, effective date, and Active status. 4. For a cost change, add a new effective dated row. Do not replace a past amount when the new cost is meant to apply only from a later date. Retire a cost Deactivate a cost that should no longer be selected for future use. Check production dates and existing Job Orders before retiring it; past production should continue to use the cost version effective on its date. What happens in the books Maintaining a cost row does not post a journal and does not change the quantity or value of existing warehouse stock. It supplies a production cost input. Production and its reports use the effective cost when calculating the finished output and related production costs. Rights Inventory Valuation access allows viewing the company's cost list; write allows adding, editing, or deactivating lines. Company access is enforced. Questions and mistakes Item is not selectable: confirm it is active, is a Finished Good or Semi Finished Good, and has an active BOM. This is not the stock on hand value I need: use Stock Valuation or Inventory Aging for warehouse stock value; this screen holds unit costs used for production. A production order used the old amount: compare its production date with each cost row's Effective From date. The cost is chosen by effective date, not by which row was entered last. A cost cannot be added: choose the selected company's eligible item, enter a positive unit cost, and supply an effective date. Historical production costs appear changed: keep prior effective dated rows active for the dates they cover; add a new row for a later change instead of editing the historical amount. Related pages Bill of Materials bill of materials.html · Production production.html · Material Variance material variance.html · Stock Valuation stock valuation.html

pages.title: Inventory Aging
pages.summary: Age stock on hand by FIFO receipt layers as at a date, with value or quantity buckets by warehouse/category.
pages.text: Inventory Aging What it is for Inventory Aging reconstructs stock on hand as at a date, then ages it by receipt layer using first in first out FIFO . It reports six age buckets and can show either value or quantity, by warehouse/category and item. Before you start Posted stock transactions, including warehouse movements and reversals, are available through the as at date. The user has Inventory Aging access for the selected company. The report's buckets are fixed: 0–30, 31–60, 61–90, 91–180, 181–365, and over 365 days. Step by step 1. Select company and As at date. Optionally narrow to a warehouse and item category. 2. Choose whether to include items with no stock. Search by item after the report loads. 3. Run the report and review on hand quantity/value by age bucket, last receipt, and last issue. Toggle Show quantities, not values to switch the bucket columns from value to quantity. 4. Click an item code to open it in the Stock Ledger stock ledger.html , from its oldest receipt still on hand to the as at date. If the report is for one warehouse, the ledger runs at once; for all warehouses, choose the warehouse there. Back to Inventory Aging returns. 5. Copy or print the filtered report. Use the as at date and warehouse/category scope shown in the report when sharing totals. 6. Investigate any warning that issues exceed receipts on record; that excess has no receipt layer/date to age. What happens in the books This is a read only report and creates no journal. It replays posted stock in date order, consumes the oldest receipt layers first, and carries those layers' dates through warehouse transfers. Reversed documents drop out when the reversal is also dated on or before the as at date. The ledger stores moving average value rather than per receipt cost, so bucket values are allocated in proportion to bucket quantities. Rights INVENTORYAGING access controls viewing, limited by company access. Questions and mistakes Age differs from purchase invoice date: age follows posted stock receipt layers, not vendor invoice date. Transfer did not reset the age: this is intentional; warehouse transfers preserve the original receipt dates. Aging total differs from Stock Valuation: compare the same as at date and scope; Stock Valuation is a current snapshot, while this report reconstructs historical stock. Some quantity has no age: the report flags quantity issued beyond receipt history; investigate missing/legacy stock movements. Value is not the original batch price: valuation uses moving average cost and distributes it over FIFO age quantities. Related pages Stock Valuation stock valuation.html · Stock Ledger stock ledger.html · Batch Expiry batch expiry.html

pages.title: Batch / Expiry Report
pages.summary: Review batches and expiry dates to see which stock is close to expiry or needs action.
pages.text: Expiry / Batch Report What it is for Expiry / Batch Report reconstructs remaining stock by item, warehouse, and batch as at a selected date. It flags expired, soon to expire, unexpired, and batches without an expiry date, and supports a trace to the Stock Ledger. Before you start Posted movements through the as at date include the batch/expiry details needed for the items being reviewed. The company, as at date, and expiry warning window are known. The default window is 90 days. The user has BATCHEXPIRY access to the company. Step by step 1. Select company, As at date, Expiring within days, and whether to include only batch tracked items. 2. Optionally filter by warehouse and fixed item category, then run the report. 3. Search by item or batch and filter statuses: Expired, Expiring, both, OK, or No expiry date. Review received date, expiry date, days to expiry, remaining quantity, and value. 4. Use the summary totals to prioritize expired/soon expiring stock. Copy or print the filtered result for action. 5. Select a row to open Stock Ledger for that item/warehouse from its receipt date through the as at date; Back returns to the report. What happens in the books This is a read only report; it does not post, reserve, or change a batch. It rebuilds batch layers from posted stock movements: issues take a named batch first, otherwise the earliest expiring batch first FEFO ; warehouse transfers carry the batch's receipt/expiry data. Values use the item's moving average warehouse cost distributed across batch quantities, not an independent cost per batch. Rights BATCHEXPIRY access controls report viewing, subject to company access. Questions and mistakes Batch is missing: check the selected as at date, warehouse/category filters, and whether posted receipts recorded its batch number. No expiry date: some inbound movements carry a batch without an expiry; a later receipt of that same batch can supply the previously recorded expiry. Remaining quantity seems wrong: verify named batch issues, FEFO issues without a batch, reversals, and transfers in the Stock Ledger. Value differs from the original receipt price: this report allocates current item/warehouse moving average value across the remaining batch layers. Item is not batch tracked: clear Batch tracked items only to include it where its movements contain batch details. Related pages Stock Ledger stock ledger.html · Inventory Aging inventory aging.html · Item Master item master.html · Warehouse Movement warehouse movement.html

pages.title: Reorder / Low Stock Report
pages.summary: Identify items below their reorder level and see any recommended purchase shortfall.
pages.text: Reorder / Low Stock Report What it is for Reorder / Low Stock Report shows which items need replenishment because they are below their reorder level or have a shortage against the target value. Before you start The item reorder levels are set correctly in Item Master. The company uses a warehouse or stock range that matches the operational flow. Step by step 1. Open Reorder / Low Stock Report . 2. Choose the company and the warehouse or stock range. 3. Run the report and review the items that need action. What happens in the books This report is for planning and purchasing. It does not create or post stock entries by itself. Rights Read or report access is normally sufficient. Questions and mistakes If the report shows no low stock, check whether reorder levels were set and whether the current stock figures are up to date. If the stock is low but no order is created, confirm the operational process for raising the purchase request or PO.

pages.title: Customer Master
pages.summary: Keep each customer record complete so sales orders, delivery notes and customer invoices can be raised correctly.
pages.text: Customer Master Data What it is for Customer Master stores the customer record used by the sales workflow. It provides the identity, credit and contact details needed for sales orders, invoices and customer statements. Before you start The company and customer account rules are already configured. The sales type and credit terms are known. The customer has the address, tax and contact details required for billing. Step by step 1. Open Customer Master and choose the company. 2. Add or update the customer's basic details. 3. Complete the sales and credit information needed for invoicing and statements. 4. Save the record and test it in a sales order or invoice. Tax registration Beside the Tax Registration No. a UAE TRN, an Indian GSTIN … , choose the customer's tax registration type registered, unregistered, composition, SEZ, overseas, consumer and its state / emirate . In India the state decides the place of supply: within the company's own state GST is charged as CGST and SGST, otherwise as IGST see Tax Configuration tax configuration.html . A registered party in India needs its GSTIN, which is checked: its first two digits must be the state chosen, and its last character must agree with the rest. A UAE TRN of a registered party is 15 digits starting 100. The City and PIN / postal code go on the customer's e invoices. India's e invoice needs both; an Indian PIN code is 6 digits, not starting with 0. A customer in a foreign currency Set Default Currency to the customer's currency for example USD and its invoices, payments and statement are in it, at the rates in Currency Configuration currencies.html . Leave it on the company default for a local customer. Once the customer has invoices or payments, its currency can't change: create a new customer for another currency. What happens in the books The customer master is a setup record, not a journal by itself. It provides the identity and account references used in trade receivables and sales processing. Rights Usually a sales or master data role can maintain customers; full setup rights stay with admin or finance support. Questions and mistakes If a customer does not appear in sales screens, check that the record is saved for the right company. "The mobile number … is already … 's" : each customer of a company has their own phone mobile number, so the Retail Sales counter can find them by it. The number is compared on its digits, so 050 123 4567 and +971 50 123 4567 are the same. Use the existing customer, or correct the number. Customers saved with the same number before this rule keep saving while their number doesn't change. If the balance or statement does not match expectation, verify the customer account and sales type setup.

pages.title: Sales Invoice Setup
pages.summary: Set the default rules and accounts used when customer sales are invoiced and posted.
pages.text: Sales Invoice Configuration What it is for Sales Invoice Setup defines the company defaults for sales document processing. It keeps the invoicing rules consistent across the sales process and the trade receivables posting. Before you start The company and its general ledger accounts are set up. Tax, discount and output tax treatment are known. The sales team knows which sales types, return accounts and defaults are used. Step by step 1. Open Sales Invoice Setup and choose the company. 2. Review each default that affects invoices, credit notes and tax treatment. 3. Confirm the sales type defaults and account links. 4. Save and test with a small sales order or invoice. Invoices may deliver stock directly per company, off unless you switch it on : choose the company, tick it and Save . Then a Customer Invoice customer invoice.html can have item lines and deliver them itself when posted. Off, stock leaves only with a Delivery Note delivery note.html . Default tax code a Sales Type, optional : where the company has a Tax Configuration tax configuration.html , the tax code of the Sales Type's direct lines on a Customer Invoice customer invoice.html , and of its items that have no code of their own for example SR, or GST18 . What happens in the books This setup does not create an entry by itself. It determines how the ERP posts customer sales and related receivables and tax entries later in the workflow. E invoicing UAE An invoice taxed by line carries each line's VAT category S, Z, E, O, AE and rate, with a subtotal per category, in its e invoice. Under E invoicing UAE , choose the company, tick E invoicing on and give the date it starts. From that date each posted Customer Invoice, and each Sales Return as a credit note , to a customer with a TRN gets its e invoice in the UAE format PINT AE , checked for what it needs. The invoice shows Ready to send , Not ready with what is missing or Not e invoiced a customer without a TRN , and its XML can be downloaded. Sending goes through your Accredited Service Provider ASP once one is chosen and connected; until then nothing is sent. The company needs its 15 digit TRN in Company Master Tax numbers . India GST. A company under India GST in Tax Configuration tax configuration.html uses the same switch. Its e invoice is the IRP's JSON schema 1.1 , built for each posted invoice and credit note to a registered business, an SEZ or a customer abroad. A consumer or an unregistered buyer is Not e invoiced . It needs: the company's GSTIN Company Master → Tax numbers, type GSTIN , address, city and PIN code; the customer's GSTIN, address, city and PIN code Customer Master ; an HSN or SAC code on every item Item Master . Download JSON IRP gives the file. The IRN and the signed QR code come from the IRP through a GSP once one is chosen and connected; until then nothing is reported. Sales reps Under Sales reps , choose the company. Rep Cash Clearing account : the account the reps' cash waits on until the cashier takes it a postable account of the company; not a cash or bank account, nor a vendor's or customer's control account . Choose it before the reps collect cash. It can't change while a rep still holds cash on it. Add a sales rep : the employee, their code letters and digits, e.g. AK; the employee number if left blank , whether they are a Sales manager sees every customer , and their customers each customer has one rep . The code is in their receipt numbers, RC AK 000001, and stays theirs: no other rep can take it. The rep then works from the Employee Portal: see Sales reps in the Employee Portal sales rep portal.html . Their orders come in as draft Sales Orders to confirm. Their collections are final at once, each with its receipt. The list shows what each rep holds: Cash held not yet taken by the cashier and Cheques held not yet received from the rep . Receipts lists a rep's receipts with what each is now: With the rep , Part handed over , Handed over , Cleared , Bounced or Cancelled . Cancel with Cash & Bank's post right cancels a wrong receipt, with the reason: it is reversed, and the customer owes it again. Its number stays, marked cancelled. Cash the cashier has already taken can't be cancelled until that Cash Receipt is reversed, and a cheque only while it is pending. Rights Normally restricted to finance support or admin level setup roles. Questions and mistakes If invoices do not post as expected, recheck the account determination, sales type and company defaults. A missing output tax or receivables account is a common cause of failed invoice posting.

pages.title: Price Listing
pages.summary: Review and maintain the item prices and rates used for sales transactions and customer orders.
pages.text: Price Listing What it is for Price Listing shows the current sales prices used by the company. It is where price rules, customer pricing and standard list prices are reviewed and updated. Before you start The item master is complete. The company and sales type are known. The pricing policy is agreed for the customer or item group. Step by step 1. Open Price Listing and filter by item, customer or sales type. 2. Review the effective price and any discount or price basis. 3. Update the list or customer price when the commercial terms change. 4. Save and test the quotation or sales order using the new price. Prices include tax : tick it for a list whose prices already hold the tax a shop's prices, for example . Where the company has a Tax Configuration tax configuration.html , a Customer Invoice customer invoice.html for an order on this list takes the tax out of the price instead of adding it. Untick it as it starts for prices before tax. What happens in the books Price Listing itself does not create accounting entries. It just sets the rate the sales transaction uses when it is posted. Rights Sales managers, pricing maintainers and admin users typically have access; end users normally only read. Questions and mistakes A sales order using the wrong price usually means the item or customer pricing was not updated. If the price list is blank, check whether the item is active and whether the company filter is correct.

pages.title: Sales Order
pages.summary: Record the customer order before delivery and invoicing, with the right pricing and quantities.
pages.text: Sales Order What it is for Sales Order captures the customer's commitment to buy goods or services. It formalises the item, quantity, price and delivery plan before stock leaves the warehouse. Before you start The customer and pricing are in place. The item and stock basis are valid. The delivery date and warehouse are known. Step by step 1. Open Sales Order and choose the customer and company. 2. Add the item lines, quantity and requested price. 3. Confirm the delivery schedule and any discounts. To enter many lines at once, fill them in Excel: Copy Table copies the lines with their headings Item Code, Warehouse, Quantity, Unit Price , also on an empty grid. Copy the rows from Excel and click Paste from Excel or click into a cell of the grid and press Ctrl+V ; the headings row is skipped. Where the order has a price list and the item is on it, the price list's price is used; otherwise the pasted price. If a row has an item code or warehouse that isn't found, a quantity that isn't a number above zero or a price that isn't a number, nothing is pasted and the message names the rows to fix. 4.
