Save or submit for approval if the company requires it. 5. Use the order to create the delivery note or invoice when the goods are ready. Proforma Invoice Proforma Invoice at the top of a saved order prints the order for the customer, or saves it as a PDF from the print dialog, for example for an advance payment or a letter of credit. It posts nothing and is not a tax invoice. It has its own number, from the PI series in Numbering numbering.html , for example PI 26 01 000004 . The number is given the first time the proforma is printed and kept with the order, so every reprint shows the same one. It prints what is saved: save your changes first. A draft order not yet confirmed prints marked DRAFT . A cancelled order has no proforma. From a saved document, Create next starts the next step and Linked documents shows the documents before and after it. See Working with screens working with screens.html linked documents and create next . Estimated tax For a company with a Tax Configuration tax configuration.html , the grid shows below its total the Estimated tax and the Total with tax : what the invoice will charge, by each item's tax code at its rate on the order date and, under India GST, CGST + SGST or IGST by the customer's state. It is an estimate: nothing is posted, and the invoice works out the tax again when it is made. Each line's components are rounded as the invoice rounds them. With a price list price listing.html whose prices include tax, the tax shown is the part included in the prices, and nothing is added. The Proforma Invoice proforma invoice prints the same estimate, by tax code, and the total with tax. An item without a tax code is named in place of the estimate: give it one in Item Master item master.html . What happens in the books A sales order is a commercial document, not a financial journal. The accounting entry is created later when a delivery or invoice is posted. Rights Sales staff need access and draft rights; approval rights are used where the company requires higher approval. Questions and mistakes If a line is missing, check whether the customer or item was entered correctly. If an order cannot be posted, verify the customer status and the item stock status or price basis.

pages.title: Delivery Note
pages.summary: Deliver the ordered goods and record the stock movement out of the warehouse to the customer.
pages.text: Delivery Note (Goods Dispatch) What it is for Delivery Note records the movement of stock out of the company to the customer. It is the link between the sales order and the customer invoice. Before you start The sales order and customer records are complete. The item and warehouse stock are available. The delivery date is in an open period. Step by step 1. Open Delivery Note and choose the company and customer. 2. Select the sales order or inventory lines to deliver. 3. Check the item, quantity, warehouse and delivery date. 4. Post the note. The stock ledger reduces the item quantity and records the issue to a customer. 5. Until a posted customer invoice includes it, the delivery is a Home task for the Invoicing team set in Approval Configuration approval configuration.html or, with no team, for you . The list's invoicing column shows it as Pending invoice . A Delivery Note can also be made by a Customer Invoice customer invoice.html with item lines, where the company invoices stock directly: it is posted with the invoice, already matched to it, and reversed with it. From a saved document, Create next starts the next step and Linked documents shows the documents before and after it. See Working with screens working with screens.html linked documents and create next . What happens in the books The delivery note updates stock movement and supports the later customer invoice. It usually does not create the final trade receivable posting by itself, unless the system is designed to do so. Rights Users need access and post rights for customer delivery processing. Questions and mistakes If delivery is refused, check the stock availability and delivery date. Mismatched customer or order lines usually mean the sales order or warehouse selection was wrong.

pages.title: Customer Invoice
pages.summary: Raise the customer bill and post the receivable to the company books against the delivered goods or services.
pages.text: Customer Invoice Processing What it is for Customer Invoice finalises the sale and posts the customer receivable. It matches the delivered goods or service to the sale and creates the finance entry for the receivable and income. Before you start The delivery note or sales order is complete. The customer account and sales type are valid. The invoice amount and taxes are ready for review. Step by step 1. Open Customer Invoice and select the company. 2. Choose the customer and the relevant delivery lines. 3. Review the items, quantities, amounts and tax before posting. 4. Save or post the invoice once the billing is confirmed. 5. Review the receivable impact in the ledger and statements. Selling from stock on the invoice Where the company allows it Sales Invoice Configuration → Invoices may deliver stock directly , the invoice has Item Lines : goods it delivers itself, without a separate Delivery Note. Add Item : type the item code, choose the warehouse and enter the quantity. The price comes from the customer's price list where the item is on it, and can be changed. From Sales Order : the customer's order lines still to deliver. Tick the lines and the quantities to invoice now; the item, warehouse and price are the order's. Whatever you don't invoice stays open on the order. Choose one Sales Type for the item lines. When the invoice is posted, a Delivery Note is made and posted for its item lines: the stock leaves at its average cost with its cost of sales , the order counts the quantities as delivered, and the invoice shows "Delivered with Delivery Note …". If there isn't enough stock, the posting is refused and nothing changes. Print delivery slip prints the items and quantities, without prices, for the driver or the store. Reversing the invoice also reverses its Delivery Note, so the stock comes back. A return is made in Sales Return, as for any delivered invoice. Tax by line Where the company has a Tax Configuration tax configuration.html UAE VAT, India GST or a tax of its own , the invoice has no Tax % . Each line is taxed by its own tax code instead: a delivered or item line takes its item's code Item Master ; a direct line, its Sales Type's default code Sales Invoice Configuration , as does an item without a code; the rate is the code's rate on the invoice date ; the discount is spread over the lines in proportion before tax; the Tax box lists each line: its taxable value, code, rate, the components for example CGST 9 % and SGST 9 % and the tax, and a summary by code. The total adds the tax. To give a line another code, choose it in the line's Tax code . That needs Customer Invoice's change tax code right Admin and Finance Manager by default ; without it the codes are shown, not changed. Place of supply India GST : the customer's state from Customer Master. Change it when the goods go to another state a ship to address . Within the company's own state the tax is CGST + SGST UTGST in a union territory ; to another state, an SEZ or abroad, IGST. Under UAE VAT, the emirate is kept for the VAT return. Prices that include tax : a line delivered against a Sales Order on a price list marked Prices include tax Price Listing holds its tax: the tax is taken out of the price and nothing is added to the total. Its revenue is the price less that tax. Posting credits each component to its own output account Tax Configuration , and records the codes as used, so they can no longer be removed there. The printed invoice shows each line's rate and tax with the HSN / SAC code under GST , a summary by code with each component, and the place of supply. A posted invoice keeps the codes and rates it was posted with, whatever changes later. For example: Example Traders , a registered customer in the company's own state, is invoiced 10 steel sheets at 50.00 GST 18 % and freight of 100.00 GST 5 % , with 60.00 off. The taxable values are 450.00 and 90.00; CGST and SGST are 42.75 each; the total is 625.50. A customer in a foreign currency If the customer's Default Currency Customer Master is not the default currency, its invoice is in that currency: the screen shows Currency and rate : the rate on the invoice date, from Currency Configuration currencies.html ; you may type another rate for example the bank's , with a reason; the total shows in the customer's currency, with its value in the default currency beside it; for now such an invoice takes item lines and direct lines . Delivery Notes made separately are priced in the default currency, so they can't be attached to it. The books are in the default currency, at the invoice's rate; each line keeps its foreign amount too. The printed invoice gives the total in the customer's currency. With VAT, it also gives, below it, the rate with the VAT and the total in the default currency, as VAT rules require. With no VAT an export, for example , it shows nothing in the default currency. Project Once the company has projects, the invoice has a Project field: every line the invoice posts carries it, for the Project Report project report.html . From a saved document, Create next starts the next step and Linked documents shows the documents before and after it. See Working with screens working with screens.html linked documents and create next . What happens in the books The customer invoice creates the receivable and the sales revenue or tax entries. It usually represents the formal billing step that follows the delivery. E invoice If the company e invoices Sales Invoice Configuration , a posted invoice shows its E invoice : Ready to send , Not ready with what is missing for example the customer's address , or Not e invoiced for a customer without a TRN. Download XML gives the file; after fixing the missing data, Check again . Nothing is sent until the company's ASP is connected. Under India GST it is the IRP's JSON instead Download JSON IRP , for a registered business, an SEZ or a customer abroad: see Sales Invoice Configuration sales invoice setup.html . Rights Users need access and post rights for sales invoicing, plus approval if the company uses invoice approval. Questions and mistakes If the invoice is blocked, check the customer or sales type setup. "No exchange rate for USD on or before …" : enter a rate in Currency Configuration → Rates. "The rate … differs from the USD rate on …: give the reason" : say why you use another rate, or put the suggested one back. "This company does not invoice stock directly" : switch it on in Sales Invoice Configuration, or deliver with a Delivery Note. "at most N can be invoiced now" : an order line can be invoiced up to what is still to deliver and reserved for it. If the amount differs from the order or delivery, recheck the price, taxes and quantity.

pages.title: Sales Return / Credit Note
pages.summary: Record returns from customers, reverse the sale and create the credit note to the customer.
pages.text: Sales Return / Credit Note What it is for Sales Return / Credit Note handles returned stock or a customer cancelled sale. It returns the inventory to stock and creates the document to reduce the customer's receivable. Before you start The original customer invoice or delivery is known. The customer and company details are valid. The option to return stock or reverse the sale is confirmed. Step by step 1. Open Sales Return / Credit Note and choose the company. 2. Select the customer and the original invoice or delivery line. 3. Enter the return quantity and the reason for the return. 4. Post the return. The stock ledger and receivable balance update accordingly. 5. Review the resulting credit note and any variance entries created. What happens in the books The return reduces the customer receivable and may re enter stock. It can also trigger a sales return variance if the value differs from the original invoice. For a customer in a foreign currency, the credit note is in its currency at the invoice's rate, not the rate on the return date, so it takes back exactly what the invoice booked; the stock comes back at its cost in the default currency. An invoice taxed by line Tax Configuration tax configuration.html : each returned line takes back its share of that line's tax, by quantity, at the codes and rates the invoice was posted with. Each component goes back to the account the invoice credited, and the Tax line shows by line . A line whose price included tax takes back its tax from within the price. E invoice If the company e invoices Sales Invoice Configuration , a posted return shows its E invoice a credit note : Ready to send , Not ready with what is missing for example the customer's address , or Not e invoiced for a customer without a TRN. Download XML gives the file; after fixing the missing data, Check again . Nothing is sent until the company's ASP is connected. Under India GST it is the IRP's JSON instead Download JSON IRP , for a registered business, an SEZ or a customer abroad: see Sales Invoice Configuration sales invoice setup.html . Rights Users need access and post rights; some companies require approval on returns as part of control. Questions and mistakes If the return is not allowed, the original invoice or delivery may already have been reversed or closed. If the value is not expected, check whether the return is using the original sale price or a revised cost basis.

pages.title: Retail Sales
pages.summary: Process a retail transaction at the counter, settle the sale and print or record the receipt.
pages.text: Retail Sales What it is for Retail Sales has four tabs: Counter , Sales , Returns , and Setup . Counter records a sale; Sales reports and opens completed transactions; Returns records eligible partial returns; Setup configures company defaults and payment methods. Returns is visible only to users with the return right. Before you start In Setup , configure the default Sales Type, store warehouse, sales cost center, tax inclusive retail price list/tax rate, Retail Customer receivable account, return period, counter price/discount permissions, receipt options, and payment methods/account mappings. For a company with a Tax Configuration tax configuration.html , every item sold has a tax code in Item Master item master.html ; Setup's single tax rate is then not used. Items are active, stocked in the store warehouse, and have a retail price or the user is permitted to change prices. User rights are set for selling, setup changes, reports, reversal, and returns. Step by step Counter tab 1. Select company, date, customer, Sales Type, and store warehouse. Enter optional invoice bill to details when needed. To find a customer, type part of their code, name or mobile number in Find above the customer list. If no customer has that mobile number, New customer with this mobile adds one there you enter the name , for a user who may add customers in Customer Master. The new customer is a Local customer of the company, on the Retail Customer's receivables account; complete their details in Customer Master later if needed. A mobile number belongs to one customer of a company. 2. Scan the item's barcode or enter its code/name. Confirm stock, quantity, price, and any allowed line discount. A barcode configured as a pack can add its pack quantity. 3. Add one or more payment lines. Cash may be over tendered and produces change; non cash methods cannot exceed the sale total. A Retail Customer must pay in full; an existing customer may leave an on account balance. 4. Review the totals: Items is the number of units on the sale; with a discount, Subtotal is the amount before it. Then the tax inclusive total, tax by each item's rate, when the company has a Tax Configuration , discount, paid amount, change, and any balance due. Confirm the sale. The screen assigns a transaction number and can print the configured receipt on confirmation. Sales tab Filter sales by date range and show either the sales list or the payment method report. Open a sale to review/print its invoice, return items with the return right , or reverse the entire sale with the applicable posting right . A user without the all sales report right sees only sales they billed. Returns tab Find the original invoice by scanning its receipt barcode or entering its invoice number. Enter return quantities, a reason, and the refund breakdown, then confirm. The open on account balance is reduced first; the rest is refunded by the original payment mix. A promotion portion is reversed rather than paid out. Returns must be within the configured return period unless it is set to no limit. Setup tab Set the company defaults and receipt options, then map every payment method to its ledger account. Cash, card, and QR methods use cash/bank/clearing Asset accounts; Promotion uses a discount Expense account and requires a promotion code. Verify the Retail Customer and sales defaults before enabling counter use. What happens in the books Confirming a sale posts one journal and an inventory transaction: payment accounts are debited for amounts received, Trade Receivables is debited for any customer balance, Discount Given is debited, Sales revenue and Output Tax are credited, and inventory cost is debited to Sales COGS/credited to inventory. The sale number uses the retail reference sequence. A full reversal mirrors the original sale. A partial return posts the return's sales/tax/discount/refund and restores stock at the cost it left at. With a Tax Configuration tax configuration.html , each line is taxed by its item's code at the rate on the sale date. Retail prices include the tax, so the tax is taken out of each line's price after its discount. The place of supply is the company's own state for the Retail Customer, and the customer's state otherwise, so under India GST a counter sale is CGST + SGST. Each component posts to its own output account, and the receipt prints the tax by code. A return takes back each line's share of the tax by quantity, and the last return of a line takes exactly what is left of it. Rights RETAILSALES access opens the screen; post permits selling and full reversal; write maintains Setup; report permits viewing all users' sales; return permits partial returns. Without report, users see their own billed sales. Company access applies. Questions and mistakes Counter is unavailable: configure the company in Setup first; the default warehouse, Sales Type, cost center, and receivables account are required. An item has no tax code: with a Tax Configuration the sale is refused; give the item its code in Item Master. Item cannot be added: check company eligibility, status, barcode, stock in the store warehouse, price list date, and whether price changes are allowed. Sale cannot be confirmed: check quantities, payment totals, required payment references, Retail Customer full payment rule, and the company's open period status. Payment method/account is wrong: correct the mapping in Setup; a confirmed sale is corrected by reversal, not by changing its original payment line. Return cannot be found or confirmed: confirm invoice number, return right, remaining unreturned quantity, reason, and configured return window. Refund differs from original tender: the open account balance is reduced first; remaining refund follows original payment proportions and promotion amounts are not paid as cash. Related pages Sales Invoice Setup sales invoice setup.html · Price Listing price listing.html · Sales Return sales return.html · Stock Availability stock availability.html

pages.title: Sales reps in the Employee Portal
pages.summary: Sales reps see their customers, send orders, collect cash and cheques with a receipt at once, and see what they hold, from the Employee Portal on their phone.
pages.text: What it is for A sales rep uses the Employee Portal on their phone. Its Sales tab shows the rep's customers with each one's balance and overdue amount, and lets the rep send an order and collect a payment. An order is a draft the office confirms. A collection is final at once : the customer gets its receipt straight away, and the rep holds the cash or the cheque until they hand it to the office. Before you start The rep is an employee with portal access Employees → portal , and has a cost center on their employee record. In Sales Invoice Configuration sales invoice setup.html sales reps → Sales reps , the office chooses the company's Rep Cash Clearing account, adds the rep with their code in their receipt numbers and their customers. A Sales manager sees all the company's customers. The customers have a price list Price Listing, by their classification . Step by step 1. Open the portal and the Sales tab. 2. New order on a customer: choose items at the customer's price list price; the stock free to sell is shown , quantities and the warehouse, then Send the order to the office . It is a draft Sales Order the office confirms; the stock is reserved then. 3. Collect on a customer: choose Cash or Cheque and the amount. A cheque takes its number, date, bank and a photo. 4. What it pays : the customer's open invoices are listed, the oldest first. Tick the ones the payment settles the amount fills in, up to what each invoice owes ; what is left goes on account , for the office to match later. 5. Record and give the receipt . The receipt opens: its number, the customer, the amount in figures and words, cash or the cheque, and the invoices it pays. Share sends it as a PDF through the phone's own share sheet WhatsApp, email … ; Download PDF saves it. 6. I hold , at the top of the Sales tab, shows the cash and the cheques the rep still holds. My receipts lists every receipt with what it is now, and opens one to share it again. Your receipts and what you hold Each rep numbers their own receipts, RC <code 000001 , then 000002 and so on, cash and cheques together. A number is never used twice. Cash stays on the rep until the cashier takes it: they enter a Cash Receipt in Cash & Bank cash and bank.html cash from a sales rep , choose the rep and match the rep's receipts. The receipt then shows Handed over or Part handed over , and I hold drops by itself. A cheque is a post dated cheque at once, with the rep until the office ticks it received from the rep in PDC Received post dated cheques.html cheques a sales rep collected . It then shows Handed over , later Cleared or Bounced . A wrong receipt a wrong amount or customer is cancelled by the office only, with the reason: it shows Cancelled , and the rep gives a new receipt. What happens in the books Cash: Dr Rep Cash Clearing against the rep · Cr the customer, at once. The cashier's Cash Receipt then moves it: Dr Cash · Cr Rep Cash Clearing. A cheque: Dr PDC Received Clearing · Cr the customer, at once, as any PDC Received; it clears to the bank on its date. Either way the customer owes less from the moment the receipt is given. Good to know The portal needs a connection: nothing is kept on the phone. Prices come from the price list only; the rep can't change them. A customer invoiced in a foreign currency is not collected from the portal: the office records its receipts. For example: Sam Seller code SS collects 350.00 in cash from Corner Shop , ticking their invoice of 300.00; 50.00 goes on account. The receipt RC SS 000001 is shared by WhatsApp; Sam holds 350.00 until the cashier takes it.

pages.title: HR Setup
pages.summary: Set the company HR defaults that drive employee configuration, leave rules and payroll controls.
pages.text: HR Setup What it is for HR Setup contains the employee structure and leave rules used by Employee Master, Employee Changes, Leave, and Payroll. It is a collection of setup registers, not a general policy text box: each tab has its own records and feeds particular parts of the workflow. Tabs at a glance HR Setup has eight tabs: Grades , Designations , Employee Fields , Document Types , Leave Types , Working Calendar , Work Schedules , and Leaving Reasons . Each tab maintains a separate setup register; the sections below explain what belongs in each one. Grades Create one ordered grade ladder for the group. Each grade has a unique code, name, seniority level, and may have a minimum, midpoint, and maximum monthly basic salary for each company. The midpoint is a reference; payroll checks the employee's basic against the applicable minimum and maximum and reports a warning when it is outside the band. Designations Add job titles and, where useful, the grade range normally associated with each title. The range is a guide: an employee can be outside it, but the system warns HR rather than treating the range as a hard prohibition. Employee Fields Use Employee Fields for company specific information not already on the standard form. Each field is Date, Text, or Amount; can be compulsory or optional; belongs to Personal, Employment, or Other; and can be marked sensitive. If a custom field has values on employee records, its type cannot be changed; create a replacement field instead. Document Types Document Types control whether an employee document needs a document number or expiry date. Common types are provided to start; HR can add company specific types and retire types no longer used. Work Schedules Create named schedules with their weekend days and hours per working day. Schedules support different patterns, such as a Friday only weekend. An employee's schedule is assigned on the employee record and can be changed through an approved Employee Change from an effective date. Do not change the weekend on a schedule already used by employees; create a new schedule and transfer employees to it so leave day calculations retain their history. Leaving Reasons The reasons an employee leaves, each a Resignation , Termination or Other . The list starts with common ones for example Better opportunity, Relocation, Performance, Redundancy, End of contract, Retirement ; add your own with New reason . In Employee Master employees.html , an employee on notice or who has left must have one of these, with an optional note for any detail. Untick In use to retire a reason: employees who already have it keep it. Leave Types Leave Types define whether a type is Leave or Duty, whether it uses a balance, whether dates count as working or calendar days, and rules such as half days, gender, probation, annual or per instance limits, supporting document thresholds, and HR confirmed returns. For balance bearing leave, configure entitlement rows by grade level and completed years of service, the carry forward cap, and pay rule rows by grade level and day number. Pay may be full salary, basic only, selected fixed earnings, a percentage, or unpaid. Cover every applicable grade and day/service range: the setup displays gaps, and the Leave Register refuses a request when no applicable rule exists. Working Calendar The Working Calendar is separate for each company. It contains weekend days and public holiday date ranges. The employee's work schedule determines their weekend; company holidays still apply to them. Before you start The company, legal entity and departments are already set up. HR and Finance have agreed the grade ladder, salary bands, leave entitlement, leave pay, and working patterns. Pay elements exist before leave pay rules use selected elements. Company calendars and any different employee work schedules are known. Treat changes as policy changes: validate the rules against representative employee cases before making them active for operational use. Step by step 1. Build the grade ladder first; set pay bands for every relevant company. 2. Add designations and their normal grade ranges. 3. Define employee fields and document types before entering employees, especially any compulsory or sensitive fields. 4. Create work schedules and confirm the company weekend and hours per day. 5. Configure Leave Types. Save a new type first, then add its pay rules and, if it uses a balance, entitlements and carry forward cap. 6. Review the warning panel for uncovered grade levels or day/service ranges and close every gap. 7. Set each company's Working Calendar, including weekend and holiday ranges. Copying a previous year's holidays is a starting point; verify the new year's dates. 8. Test using employees at different grades and service lengths, including a leave request that crosses a pay rule band and a working calendar holiday. What happens in the books HR Setup does not post to the general ledger. Grades, designations, custom fields, document types, work schedules, leave rules, and calendars supply data and rules used by employee records, leave calculations, reporting, and payroll. Rights Users with HR Setup access can view setup; the HR Setup write right is needed to change it. Employees access can also permit reading setup data needed by the employee screen. Keep write access with the HR owners of these policies. Questions and mistakes Grade or designation unavailable: check that the setup record is active and that the employee's company can use it. Pay band warning: compare basic salary with that company's band; the warning is a review prompt, not an automatic salary change. No leave entitlement or pay rule: inspect the displayed grade/service/day gaps and add a non overlapping row that covers the employee. Leave days differ from expectation: check the leave type's Working or Calendar setting, the employee's schedule, company holidays, and half day settings. A used schedule's weekend needs changing: add another schedule and use Employee Change with an effective date; editing the used weekend would change day count behavior. A custom field type needs correction: if any employee already has a value, the field type is locked. Add a new field and migrate the data deliberately. Related pages Employee Master employees.html · Employee Change employee change.html · Leave leave.html · Payroll Setup payroll setup.html

pages.title: Employee Master
pages.summary: Maintain the employee record used for payroll, leave, portal access and the employee approval flow.
pages.text: Employees What it is for Employee Master is the employee's central record for identity, employment, organization, job, manager, payroll details, documents, compensation, and history. Payroll and Leave use this record to decide which employees and terms apply in a given period. The employee number is generated using the system's employee numbering format. An ERP login and an employee record are separate records; link them only when the employee needs access to the portal or another employee linked workflow. What the record contains Personal details, contact information, emergency contact, and configured HR custom fields. Employment details: company, joining and probation dates, employment type, status, and leaving date, reason and note. For someone on notice or who has left, the record shows until when they can still sign in to the ERP and the Employee Portal: until the final settlement is paid not before the last working day , and never more than 30 days after the last working day. Extend… to a date , Keep access and Use the rule change it for that person, with a reason kept in the history. An employee On notice or who has Left needs a leaving reason, chosen from the list in HR Setup → Leaving Reasons hr setup.html leaving reasons ; the note keeps any detail. A reason typed before the list existed stays until the status or reason changes. Organization and job: division, branch, cost center the department for payroll costing , location a Location from Organizational Units, the company's or a shared one; an ordinary edit changes it , a work location note, grade, designation, manager, and work schedule. Bank details, IBAN, and WPS person/routing details where applicable. Employee documents, with document type, number or expiry where configured, files, renewal history, and removal reason. Compensation versions with effective dates, fixed pay elements, and agreed variable pay terms. A history of creation and subsequent corrections or approved changes. Before you start The company has active grades, designations, organization units, custom fields, document types, and work schedules in HR Setup hr setup.html . The new employee's company, joining date, job, cost center, manager, and employment details are confirmed. Pay elements and the grade's company pay band are configured before compensation is entered. Bank and WPS data are checked against the bank's requirements. Access to pay, bank details, and sensitive fields is restricted separately. Step by step Create an employee 1. Open Employees , choose New , and complete required identity, employment, job, and organization fields. 2. Choose an active grade and designation. If the designation has a usual grade range, an out of range choice is shown as a warning. 3. Assign the cost center and, if applicable, a line manager, work schedule, ERP user, and required custom fields. 4. Enter bank and sensitive information only with the appropriate sensitive right. Users without that right do not see protected values and cannot erase them by saving other fields. 5. Save and review the generated employee number and history entry. Maintain the record After creation, ordinary personal and contact details can be maintained under employee write access. Company, grade, designation, division, branch, cost center, and work schedule are job/organization changes: process them through Employee Change employee change.html so the change has an effective date, approval, and history. HR Setup users may use Correct for a data entry mistake, with a reason recorded in history; it is not the normal route for a promotion or transfer. Use Replace manager to move all of a departing or reassigned manager's direct reports to another manager in one operation. Review the employee's direct reports before changing a manager's status to Left. Compensation and documents Compensation is a dated version, not a single amount overwritten in place. Enter fixed monthly pay elements and agreed bonus or commission terms. Use a new effective dated version for an initial entry or correction; later job/pay changes should follow the Employee Change workflow. The basic salary is checked against the company pay band. Add documents under the employee's Documents section. Select a configured document type, enter its number/expiry when required, attach the file, and use renewal rather than replacing the old record when a document is renewed. Removal is recorded with a reason; it is not an untracked deletion. What happens in the books Creating or updating an employee does not post to the general ledger. Employee cost center, compensation versions, bank details, work schedule, and employment dates are inputs used by payroll, leave calculations, approvals, and payment files. Rights Employees access/write rights control ordinary records. The separate Employees sensitive right controls compensation, bank and WPS details, and sensitive custom fields. HR Setup write permits reasoned corrections to locked job/organization fields. Document access is controlled through employee access and the supporting document workflow. Company access limits which employees a user can see. Questions and mistakes Employee missing from a period: check company, joining/leaving dates, and status for the period. Payroll includes an employee only for months overlapping employment. Cannot change company, grade, or cost center: create an Employee Change, or use Correct with a reason only when fixing a genuine entry error. Pay band warning: confirm the basic amount and the selected grade/company band; the system flags the exception for review. Employee is missing from portal or approval routing: confirm the ERP user is linked, the manager is assigned where needed, and portal access/role settings are enabled. Manager cannot be changed to Left: reassign direct reports first with Replace manager. Sensitive field appears blank: check the user's sensitive right; a user without it cannot see the saved value. Document expiry is wrong: check the document type's expiry setting and update the document record through renewal rather than overwriting its history. Related pages HR Setup hr setup.html · Employee Change employee change.html · Employee Requests employee requests.html · Payroll Run payroll run.html

pages.title: Employee Change / Update
pages.summary: Record changes to an employee’s status, pay, roles or department while keeping the payroll and approvals aligned.
pages.text: Employee Changes What it is for Employee Change is the controlled, effective dated workflow for a promotion, increment, or transfer. It preserves the before and after values, change reason, approval decisions, and the date the new job or pay takes effect. Use it for a real employment change, not to correct a typo. A one off data entry correction is made from Employee Master with Correct and a reason; that action is restricted to HR Setup writers and remains in the employee history. Before you start The employee exists and is not marked Left. The new grade, designation, organization assignment, schedule, and/or compensation are approved in principle. The effective date and written reason are known. HR has configured the grades, designation ranges, pay bands, work schedules, and pay elements in HR Setup hr setup.html and Payroll Setup payroll setup.html . Approval Configuration for Employee Changes is ready if the company requires approvals. Step by step 1. Open Employee Changes from the employee record or the Employee Change module and choose the employee. 2. Select the document type: Promotion changes grade or designation; pay may also change. A grade promotion must move to a higher level. Increment changes pay while keeping job and organization unchanged. Transfer changes company, division, branch, cost center, cost split or work schedule while keeping grade and designation unchanged. Cost split optional : share the employee's cost across cost centers by %, for example Workshop 60% and Office 40%. Add a share for each cost center; the shares add up to 100% and include the cost center above the main one, the department . Once approved, every payroll expense line of the employee salary, provisions, final settlement, interim payments is shared the same way. Approvals and reports still use the main cost center. 3. Enter the effective date and reason. For compensation, enter the new fixed pay element amounts and terms. A percentage raise can be applied to the basic; review the calculated monthly increase. 4. Review the validation warnings, including designation grade range and company pay band warnings. Check the “before” and “after” summary carefully, especially for a company transfer. 5. Save as a draft, then submit. The configured approvers act in order; a rejected change can be corrected and resubmitted. 6. After approval, verify the employee's current job and compensation history. A future dated job/organization change is applied when its effective date arrives; a future schedule is recorded from that date so leave uses the right working days. What happens in the books The change document does not post a journal. An approved pay change creates a new compensation version effective from its date; payroll uses the version in force for each month and can calculate arrears when a change is approved after its effective month was already posted. Approved job and organization changes update the employee record on the effective date. The Employee Change number and history remain available for audit. Rights Employee Changes access is needed to view documents. Its draft right prepares and submits them; approvers are assigned through Approval Configuration. Pay details are visible to users with the Employees sensitive right and to the change's approvers. Company access still applies. Questions and mistakes A second change cannot be opened: only one Draft, Pending Approval, or Rejected change may be open for an employee. Finish, delete, or resolve it first. Promotion refused: it must change grade or designation; a grade change must move to a higher level. Increment refused: it must change compensation only. Use Promotion or Transfer for job/organization changes. Transfer refused: it must change company, division, branch, cost center, cost split, or schedule, without changing grade/designation. Cost split refused: the shares must add up to 100%, have at least two cost centers of the company, and include the main cost center. Pay date refused: a new pay version cannot begin on or before the latest pay version's start date. Approved change not visible yet: check its effective date. Future dated job/organization changes do not take effect early. Pay values are hidden: grant the sensitive right only to people who need access; approvers can see the pay on the document they must decide. Related pages Employee Master employees.html · HR Setup hr setup.html · Payroll Run payroll run.html · Approvals approvals.html

pages.title: Leave
pages.summary: Register and approve leave so balances, attendance and payroll deductions remain accurate.
pages.text: Leave Register What it is for Leave is the employee leave register. It calculates the days, applicable pay treatment, balance effect, document requirement, and expected return for each entry; after approval, these day level records feed the monthly leave close and payroll. Before you start Employee, grade, work schedule, and company assignment are current. HR Setup has complete Leave Type, entitlement, pay rule, and Working Calendar configuration. Approval Configuration is set up if approval is required. Portal requests also need employee/manager links and portal access. The dates, reason, and any required supporting document are available. Step by step Enter and review leave 1. Open Leave, or start from the employee's leave card. Select the employee and leave type. 2. Enter the first and last dates, and mark a half day at either end if the type allows it. Enter the reason and attach any supporting file. 3. Review the live preview before saving. It shows counted days, pay treatment by day band, balance before/after, and any portion beyond an available balance that will be unpaid. 4. Save the document. Submit it for approval; if no approval is configured, submission approves it immediately. A portal leave request first goes to the line manager and then follows the configured approval flow. 5. The approver checks the dates, balance, pay breakdown, reason, and any document flag, then approves or rejects with a reason. Record the return or adjustment For a leave type that requires HR to confirm return, record the actual return date when the employee comes back. An early return removes the unused future days from the leave and restores the balance. If the employee returns late, record the return; the extra working days are recorded as unpaid absence. Use the employee leave card to make a balance adjustment only for a documented correction, such as a verified opening balance or earned entitlement correction. Include the reason; an adjustment is not a substitute for entering the leave itself. Month and year close At month end, review the leave summary and resolve Draft or pending leave dated up to the close date. Lock months in order. The lock records the summary and monthly accruals used by payroll. Reopen only the latest locked month, with a reason, and only while its payroll run is still Draft. At year end, review the preview of balances, carry forward caps, and lapses before confirming the leave year close. What happens in the books Leave entry, approval, return, and balance adjustment do not directly post a GL journal. The approved day lines affect available balances and monthly payroll: paid leave may reduce selected pay elements or apply a percentage; unpaid leave, absence, and partial leave affect salary deductions. Monthly leave close locks the rows payroll will use. If a closed month's leave is entered later, its pay effect is assigned to a later open month as an adjustment. Rights The Leave module's access right controls visibility; draft allows entry; post allows submit/cancel/close actions; lock controls month and year close; reopen controls reopening a locked month. Approval decisions are limited to the configured approvers. Employees and line managers use their portal workflow where enabled. Company access is enforced. Questions and mistakes Working day leave starts or ends on a day off: use the employee's schedule and company holiday calendar; working day leave must start and finish on counted working days. No leave pay rule: add a non overlapping HR Setup rule covering the employee's grade and the leave day band. Leave exceeds the available balance: the excess is split off as unpaid; verify the opening balance, accrued days, adjustments, previous approved/pending bookings, and carry forward. Supporting document expected: attach it or let the approver explicitly accept the leave without it. A missing document is recorded for reporting. Leave is blocked by overlap: review the employee's existing draft, pending, or approved leave across the date range. Month cannot be locked: settle or delete leave still in Draft or pending for dates up to the applicable close date, and lock months in sequence. Month cannot be reopened: only the latest locked month can be reopened, and not after its payroll has left Draft or December's leave year has closed. Related pages HR Setup hr setup.html · Leave Reports leave reports.html · Payroll Run payroll run.html · Employee Requests employee requests.html

pages.title: Leave Reports
pages.summary: Review leave balances, absences and managerial follow-up across the company or department.
pages.text: Leave Reports What it is for Leave Reports provides four different views for operational follow up: leave balances as of a date, the approved leave register for a period, absence only records, and a monthly calendar showing who is away. The screen tabs are Balances , Leave register , Absences , and Who is away . Before you start Leave Types, employee grades, work schedules, and company calendars are configured. The user has Leave Reports access and company access to the data required. Choose the appropriate report view and its date/month before running it. Step by step Balance report 1. Choose an as of date and run the balance report. 2. Review each employee and balance bearing leave type. The columns separate opening balance, accrued, adjusted, taken, booked, and available days. 3. Compare the grade and service rules in HR Setup with the employee's history before requesting an adjustment. Leave register and absences 1. Select the register view and enter the period from/to dates; optionally filter by leave type. 2. Review the dates, days falling inside the selected period, unpaid days, absent days, return date, and supporting document status. 3. Use the absences view to focus on unauthorized absence and late return absence. It is a report view; correct the source record in Leave if details need changing. Who is away Choose one company and a month. The calendar marks leave by type, distinguishes pending entries from approved leave, and shades weekends/holidays. Use the away only option to reduce the list to employees with entries in that month, or show everyone for coverage planning. Copy the report where available for spreadsheet follow up. What happens in the books These are report views and do not post to the ledger or change leave records. Balances are calculated from opening balances, accruals, adjustments, and approved/booked leave. The register report includes approved records; the calendar also identifies pending leave. Rights The Leave Reports access right is separate from Leave Register access, so a reports only role can view reports without being allowed to enter, approve, or close leave. Company access still restricts the report population. Questions and mistakes No balance row: check that the employee was employed on the as of date, the leave type uses a balance, and the selected company is within the user's access. Balance is unexpected: compare the as of date, opening balance date, grade/service entitlement, adjustments, booked leave, and approved leave. A pending request reduces available balance as a booking. Register differs from all leave records: the period report includes approved leave with counted lines in that period; drafts and pending requests are not approved register entries. Calendar is unavailable for multiple companies: the calendar is run for one company at a time; select the company first. A late return appears as absence: verify the return date in the Leave Register; that screen owns the source entry. Related pages Leave leave.html · HR Setup hr setup.html · Payroll Run payroll run.html

pages.title: Payroll Setup
pages.summary: Set the company payroll account, pay elements and defaults used by each payroll run.
pages.text: Payroll Setup What it is for Payroll Setup is the configuration workspace for pay elements, payroll accounting, bank/payment file layouts, loan types, provisions, and reimbursement categories. The six tabs feed the employee compensation record, payroll calculation and posting, employee loan/claim workflows, and payroll payments. It does not calculate an employee's monthly salary by itself. It defines the elements, formulas, accounts and policies that the operational modules use. Tabs at a glance The six Payroll Setup tabs are Pay Elements , Payroll Accounting , Payment Files , Loans , Provisions and Reimbursements Leaving Reasons are in HR Setup hr setup.html leaving reasons since 24/10/2026 . Use the matching section below for the setup maintained in each tab. Before you start HR and Finance have agreed the pay policies and the payroll accounting treatment. Companies and active, postable accounts are set up in the Chart of Accounts. Grades, bands, employee work schedules, leave pay rules, and company calendars are aligned in HR Setup hr setup.html . The bank's file specification is available if a WPS SIF or other payment file is needed. The company has assigned Payroll Setup access/write rights and Payroll/Loans/Interim/Settlement rights to the appropriate roles. Step by step Pay Elements Create each element with a unique code/name and classify it as Earning or Deduction , Fixed monthly amount on compensation or Variable entered for a payroll period , and mark the one fixed earning that is Basic. Set inactive elements out of use rather than reusing their code. Fixed elements form the employee's recurring compensation; variable elements such as bonus, commission, overtime, or one offs are entered for a period. Payroll Accounting For each company, choose the daily rate method: monthly amount divided by 30, by the actual days in that month, or monthly amount × 12 ÷ 365/366. Set Salaries Payable liability , Recoverable from employees asset and Salary held a liability of its own: a held salary waits there until released, see Payroll payroll run.html hold an employee s salary , and choose how leave deductions appear in the GL: pro rata against the original earnings accounts or through the element's ledger mapping. Set the optional cut off day 1–28 if the leave month is to lock before month end; blank means after month end. For each pay element, select its shared/group GL account and any company specific override. Earnings require an expense account; deductions may post to a liability or receivable. Decide whether the fixed amount is prorated for joiners, leavers and unpaid days, and whether an earning counts in gross for leave pay/overtime calculations. For variable earning elements that represent overtime, enable the overtime formula. It can be a fixed amount per run or hours × rate. For hours based OT, choose Basic or Gross, company daily rate method or fixed divisor days, employee schedule hours or fixed hours, and a weightage. Review the displayed example against the approved company formula. Payment Files Create a format for the company and bank, either from the UAE WPS SIF starter or as a blank layout. Configure file type delimited or fixed width , delimiter/extension/line ending, filename pattern, employer and bank codes, currency/reference, and the ordered header, employee record, and trailer fields required by the bank. Enter employee WPS person ID, bank routing code and IBAN in the sensitive employee fields. Preview a posted run with an appropriate payment date, then have the bank validate the output before first live use. Loans Create each loan/advance type and select its receivable account group account with optional company override . An advance is recovered at once; a loan is recovered in instalments. Optional Employee Portal limits can cap amount in months of Basic or Gross salary and number of instalments, require completion of probation, or allow only one open request of that type. Provisions For each company, configure gratuity salary base, day rate rule, minimum service, cap, start point, service slabs, expense and liability accounts and leave salary Basic or Gross base, expense and liability accounts . Add other accruals such as flight or education: fixed annual amount or a percentage of Basic/Gross, by grade level, with company account overrides and employee exceptions. Decide whether an unused accrual is paid at leaving or lapses. Opening balances already recorded in the GL are brought in through Master Data Import, not posted again here. Reimbursements Create each employee claim category with its expense account, optional company override, monthly per employee limit, receipt requirement, and maximum age of bills. Each category has its own reimbursement pay element. Approved claims are added to the relevant month's Earnings and Deductions and paid through payroll; an over limit flag is visible to approvers, who decide whether to approve it. Finish and test Save each tab and check the selected company, group account, company override, and active status. Rehearse with representative employees and a draft run; verify the calculated lines and GL impact before approving or posting production payroll. What happens in the books Payroll Setup itself makes no journal entries. Payroll Run posts earnings, deductions, net payable or recoverable amounts, and configured provisions. Loan payout/recovery, interim payments, final settlement, and provision claims create their own entries in their respective workflows. Payment file formats only produce bank files; marking payment is the action that posts the payment accounting. Rights Payroll Setup access controls viewing; its write right controls all setup tabs. Payroll, Payroll Loan, Interim Payroll, Final Settlement, and Employee Requests have separate operational rights. Keep setup changes limited to trusted payroll and finance maintainers; they can affect all future runs. Questions and mistakes Posting account rejected: it must be active and postable, be the required account type, and belong to the group or selected company as appropriate. Pay element has no account: set its group account or company override in Payroll Accounting before posting. Leave pay or overtime gross is wrong: review the element's In gross flag, the leave pay rule, and the overtime base and divisors. Joiner/leaver or unpaid days are not prorated as expected: inspect the element's Prorated setting and company daily rate method. Payroll cannot lock leave when expected: check the company's cut off day and settle leave dated up to the cutoff first. Bank rejects the file: compare the exact field order, codes, filename, delimiters/line endings, employee WPS data, and payment date with the bank's current specification; a successful preview does not guarantee bank acceptance. Loan or reimbursement request is blocked: check the type/category is active, its account is valid, and optional limits and probation rules are intentional. Provision is missing from a run: confirm the company provision is enabled, its accounts are valid, and accrual rows cover the employee's grade level. Related pages HR Setup hr setup.html · Earnings and Deductions payroll earnings deductions.html · Payroll Run payroll run.html · Loans and Advances payroll loan.html · Provisions provisions.html

pages.title: Earnings and Deductions
pages.summary: Define the earnings, deductions and allowances that payroll calculations apply each pay cycle.
pages.text: Earnings & Deductions What it is for Earnings and Deductions is the period input register for variable pay. Payroll staff enter employee specific overtime hours or amount, bonus, commission, reimbursement, accrual payout, and one off additions/deductions for a company and month. Fixed monthly compensation is maintained on the employee's dated compensation record, not here. Before you start Payroll Setup payroll setup.html has active pay elements and their accounting/overtime rules. Employees have active records and compensation effective for the month. The payroll month and company are confirmed, and payroll input totals are approved by their source records. If an item is to be paid separately, confirm it is eligible for Interim Payroll before entering it. Step by step 1. Open Earnings and Deductions and choose the company and payroll month. 2. Add a row for each employee/variable pay element. Use employee number or employee selection, the configured element, and either hours for an hours based overtime element or an amount. Add a note to identify the source or reason; paste multiple rows from a spreadsheet when appropriate. 3. Choose Run for earnings/deductions paid through the monthly payroll, or Interim for eligible amount based earnings such as a bonus or commission that will be paid separately. Hour based overtime and accrual payouts are not paid by Interim Payroll. 4. Review the register's state: for the run, entries are included in its next calculation; interim items show whether they are awaiting a batch, in a batch, or paid. 5. Correct or remove an entry while it remains editable. Recalculate the payroll draft after changing run inputs; the run captures the input version used in its calculation. 6. For Interim items, create/select an Interim Payroll batch and include the entry. It becomes locked while reserved by a batch and is marked paid only after that payment is completed. What happens in the books Entering an item does not post a journal. Run paid inputs are included in the monthly calculation and post with that run using the element's GL account and employee cost center. Interim paid earnings post when the Interim Payroll item is paid, using a payment journal and the configured element account. Rights The PAYROLLED access right controls viewing; its draft right controls adding, editing, and deleting inputs. Company access applies. Changes to run paid rows stop once the monthly run is no longer Draft; interim rows stop being editable once included in a batch. Questions and mistakes Employee is not available: check the employee's company and employment dates; the employee must be on payroll in that month. Element is not listed: only active variable elements and available provision accrual payouts are entered here. Fixed pay belongs in compensation. Hours field is required: the overtime element is configured as hours based; enter hours, not a manually calculated amount. Run total did not change: recalculate the run after editing inputs. If the run left Draft, its run paid entries can no longer be changed; follow the run's reject/reversal controls as applicable. Entry says In the draft run/Pending approval/Posted with the run: the run owns its editability. Reopen the run to review the matching calculation and status. Interim option is rejected: only an earning paid by amount is eligible; ordinary salary, hourly overtime, and accrual payouts remain with the monthly run or provision process. Interim entry is locked: remove it from its draft batch first; after approval/payment, use the batch's payment reversal workflow rather than deleting the source row. Related pages Payroll Setup payroll setup.html · Payroll Run payroll run.html · Interim Payroll payroll interim.html · Employee Requests employee requests.html

pages.title: Payroll Run
pages.summary: Calculate and post the payroll for all employees in the selected pay cycle.
pages.text: Payroll What it is for Payroll Run calculates, reviews, approves, posts, and pays one company's payroll for a month. It combines the employee compensation version in force, payroll setup, locked leave, monthly variable inputs, loan recoveries, provisions, and any arrears or carried forward net shortfall. The screen's list has Runs and Payment tabs. Within a run, the available views are Register , Costing , GL Impact , and Payment ; some views become available only after approval or posting. Before you start Employees, effective dated compensation, bank details, grades, and cost centers are current. Payroll Setup has valid element/account mappings, company daily rate settings, payable/receivable accounts, and relevant provision rules. Leave for the month is reviewed and locked in Leave leave.html . The run cannot be calculated without the locked leave month. Variable items are entered in Earnings and Deductions payroll earnings deductions.html ; loans due are active and settlements have been checked. Approval Configuration for Payroll is ready if approval is required. Confirm the month is not blocked by the accounting period lock. Step by step Calculate and review 1. In the Runs tab, filter by company, month range, and status. Create/open the run for the company and month. A company has one run for a given month. 2. Calculate the run. Eligible employees are those whose employment overlaps the month. Fixed elements come from the compensation version effective for each date and use the company's daily rate method for proration. 3. In Register , review the employee by element totals and open each payslip to inspect how earnings and deductions were calculated. The calculation considers paid leave rules, unpaid and absent days, duty, late leave adjustments, variable inputs, loan instalments, accrual payouts, and provision movements. 4. Investigate warnings before submission: missing compensation or IBAN, basic outside the grade band, negative net, or other employee specific exceptions. Correct source data and recalculate. 5. Recalculate whenever variable inputs or the locked leave data changes. The run records the versions it used and prevents submission if its leave lock or input set is stale. Approve and post 1. Submit the reviewed draft. If Approval Configuration requires approvals, the run becomes Pending Approval; otherwise it is approved and posts immediately. 2. Approvers review the net pay amount and employee slips, then approve or reject. Final approval posts the run. 2a. A cost center for this run only: open an employee's payslip in a draft run and select Change for this run . Choose the cost center, and optionally a split by % typed as codes and percentages for example CC1 60, CC2 40 , and give the reason. The employee record doesn't change, a recalculation keeps it, and the run's history shows who changed it and why. Back to the employee's undoes it. For a lasting change, use a Transfer in Employee Change employee change.html . 3. Once approved, Costing shows employer cost by employee and pay element, including provisions accrued not paid now . GL Impact previews the accounts, cost centers, debits, and credits it will post; after posting it shows the posted journal. Verify the posted journal and run status. Posting is one payroll journal dated at the month's end, with lines clubbed by account/cost center as appropriate. Pay and issue payslips After posting, review and print employee payslips. In the run's Payment view, group employees by payment method/account, review each amount, payment date/reference, and bank file, then mark groups paid. A run can be paid in parts; track unpaid balances in the list's Payment tab, which can filter posted runs still to pay or already paid. Reverse payments before reversing a paid run. Hold an employee's salary Use the Salary holds tab when a salary must not be paid for now for example, an employee who has not reported for work . 1. Choose the company in the filter above, then the employee, the month the hold starts from a month whose payroll is not yet posted , an end month if you know it blank: until released , and the reason. Select Hold salary . 2. The run works out the salary as usual. The payslip shows a Stop Salary deduction that brings the net to zero, so the employee is not paid; the amount waits on the company's Salary held account. The run lists the hold among its warnings. 3. Release asks the month the salary is paid again from and a note. Everything held is added to that month's run as Salary released and paid with it. For example, two months of 4,500.00 held are paid as 9,000.00 in the release month, on top of that month's salary. Each hold and release is in the employee's history. A leaver's final settlement payroll final settlement.html pays whatever is still held. Holding and releasing need the Payroll post right. Correct a posted run A posted run can be reversed only when its payments are reversed and later dependent payroll runs/settlements are dealt with first. Supply a reason, correct the source data, recalculate, and submit the run again. A closed accounting period may require the adjustment/repost to be dated in the first open month. What happens in the books Posting debits earning expense accounts by the payslip's cost center shared across its cost split, if any, the rounding to the largest share , credits deduction accounts, and credits Salaries Payable for positive net amounts. A negative net is debited to Recoverable from employees and carried forward into a later run. Configured gratuity, leave salary, and other accrual provisions post their expense/liability movements. Loan recoveries reduce the corresponding employee loan receivable; accrual payouts reduce the provision. A Stop Salary deduction is credited to Salary held, and a Salary released earning is debited to it. Payment is a separate journal that debits Salaries Payable and credits the cash/bank account. Rights PAYROLL access allows viewing runs and amounts; draft allows creating, recalculating, changing and submitting a run; configured approvers decide approval; post is used for reversal; payment rights control marking payment. Payroll amounts are sensitive: access is granted by the Payroll module and the approval workflow, while employee bank details and pay records have their own sensitive controls. Questions and mistakes Cannot calculate: lock leave for this company/month first, then inspect missing compensation, inactive elements, missing pay rules, and employee grade/schedule. Submission says recalculate: the leave month was reopened/changed or Earnings and Deductions changed after calculation. Recalculate and review the new totals. Employee absent from run: check company, joining date, leaving date, and any final settlement that is paying that month. Net differs from expectation: inspect the detailed slip by element, unpaid/paid leave, overtime formula, variable inputs, loan schedule, carry forward, arrears, and provision entries. Missing GL account or cost center: fix Payroll Setup or Employee Master, then retry posting. Accounts that require a cost center the Chart of Accounts chart of accounts.html rule; by default the expense accounts need an employee cost center. Approved but not posted: inspect the posting error; a missing/inactive account can leave an approved run waiting to post. Run cannot be reversed: reverse its payments first; reverse later runs or dependent final settlements before this run. Bank file is wrong: the payment file is generated from Payroll Setup and employee WPS/bank fields. Preview and validate it against the bank format before marking payment. Related pages Payroll Setup payroll setup.html · Earnings and Deductions payroll earnings deductions.html · Leave leave.html · Interim Payroll payroll interim.html · Final Settlement payroll final settlement.html · Provisions provisions.html

pages.title: Interim Payroll
pages.summary: Run an ad hoc or partial payroll when a monthly payroll needs an interim adjustment.
pages.text: Interim Payroll What it is for Interim Payroll creates a controlled payment batch between monthly payroll runs. It pays eligible approved loans/advances, posted final settlements, and variable earnings explicitly marked for interim payment. It is not a second full salary run. Before you start The source item is ready: loan/advance is approved, final settlement is posted, or an eligible amount based earning is marked Interim in Earnings and Deductions. Employee company, IBAN/WPS details, the bank file format, payment method, and payment date are checked. Approval Configuration for Interim Payroll is set up if required; the user has draft and pay rights. Step by step 1. Open Interim Payroll and start a batch for the company. Enter the payment date and optional note. 2. Select the eligible items to include. Each item can belong to only one batch at a time; review the employee, item type, and amount before saving. 3. Submit the draft batch. It follows configured approval; with no approval set up, submission approves it immediately. Rejection returns it to Draft for correction. 4. Once approved, review the payment plan by item. Generate and inspect the configured bank file where needed, then mark each item paid from the chosen cash/bank account. 5. Confirm all items are paid and the batch status is complete. If a payment must be undone, reverse the item's payment through the batch; the corresponding item becomes payable again and the batch returns to Draft when no live payment remains. What happens in the books The approval/batch itself is not a GL posting. Payment creates the accounting entry for each item: a loan payout debits the loan receivable; a final settlement clears the settlement payable/receivable; an interim earning debits its pay element account; the cash or bank account is credited. Reversal creates mirror entries. These transactions do not become part of the monthly run's salary calculation. Rights PAYROLLIP access allows viewing; draft allows creating and submitting batches; configured approvers decide; pay allows marking and reversing payments. Company access and valid cash/bank accounts still apply. Questions and mistakes Expected item is absent: confirm it is approved/posted as required, belongs to the selected company, is unpaid, and is not reserved by another batch. An earning cannot be selected: only eligible amount based earnings marked Interim can be paid here; hourly overtime and accrual payouts are excluded. Batch cannot be submitted: it must contain at least one item that is still eligible when submitted. Cannot change an item: remove it from its Draft batch first. Submitted/approved batches must follow their status and payment reversal controls. Payment fails: check that the item is still unpaid, the payment date is valid, bank/cash account is active, and Payroll Setup has the item's account mapping. Bank file preview is empty or incomplete: check the format's record fields and employee IBAN/WPS data; only items set to be paid by bank appear in that bank file. Batch total differs from expected: compare its selected item list; the total is the sum of current eligible items and should be rechecked before submit. Related pages Payroll Setup payroll setup.html · Payroll Loan / Advance payroll loan.html · Final Settlement payroll final settlement.html · Earnings and Deductions payroll earnings deductions.html

pages.title: Payroll Loan / Advance
pages.summary: Manage loan and advance recovery and posting as part of the payroll cycle.
pages.text: Loans & Advances What it is for Loans & Advances tracks employee borrowing from draft request through approval, payout, scheduled recovery, and repayment. Loan types are defined in Payroll Setup; an advance is recovered at once, while a loan is recovered in instalments through payroll. Before you start Payroll Setup contains the active loan type, asset receivable account, and intended recovery policy. The employee is active, belongs to the selected company, and the amount/start month/instalment are agreed. Approval Configuration for Loan / Advance is ready if approval is required. A valid cash/bank account is available for payout, and Payroll Setup's payment file is configured if the payout will be included in an interim bank file. Step by step 1. Open Loans & Advances, select the employee and active type, then enter principal, instalment for a loan , recovery start month, and note. 2. Save the draft and submit it. The approval amount is the principal. A rejection returns it for correction; approval alone does not pay the employee. 3. Include the approved loan/advance in an Interim Payroll batch and pay it from cash/bank. The payout posts to the receivable account configured for that type. 4. Review the running balance and monthly recovery history. Payroll deducts the scheduled amount in each run, oldest due items first, but does not recover more than the employee's available net pay. 5. When necessary, use the loan schedule controls to skip a month, change an instalment from a specified month, or record an early repayment. Review the new balance and next due amount. 6. At leaving, review the balance with Final Settlement; the settlement deducts the remaining loan balance. Once a final settlement is beyond Draft, payout/repayment actions wait for that settlement. What happens in the books Payout debits the loan type's employee receivable and credits cash/bank. Each posted Payroll Run recovery credits that receivable and reduces the loan balance; early repayments use their own payment journal. A reversed payroll run restores the recovery balance. Final Settlement clears the remaining receivable when the employee leaves. Rights PAYROLLLOAN access controls viewing; draft prepares/submits loan records; configured approvers decide; pay controls payout and repayment. Payroll Setup write is required to maintain types and receivable accounts. Sensitive employee compensation remains subject to Employees sensitive access. Questions and mistakes Loan type missing: confirm it is active in Payroll Setup → Loans and the user can access the company. Approval completed but no money received: approved status is not payout; include the item in an Interim Payroll batch and mark it paid. Loan not recovered in a run: check status, recovery start month, skips/instalment changes, outstanding balance, and whether a settlement has taken control of the employee's balance. Recovery is less than the scheduled instalment: the run caps recovery at the employee's net amount; the remaining balance stays due. Receivable account error: the group account must be an active postable Asset account; a company override must belong to that company. Loan is already in another batch: remove it from the other Draft batch or finish/reverse that payment before reserving it again. Employee has a final settlement: changes and repayments are held while a settlement past Draft controls the remaining balance. Related pages Payroll Setup payroll setup.html · Payroll Run payroll run.html · Interim Payroll payroll interim.html · Final Settlement payroll final settlement.html

pages.title: Final Settlement
pages.summary: Finalise the employee’s end-of-service or exit settlement with all remaining balances and payments.
pages.text: Final Settlements What it is for Final Settlement calculates and clears the amounts due when an employee leaves. It brings together salary months not yet paid, leave balance, gratuity, other accruals, notice pay, additional pay/deductions, and outstanding loans in one effective dated exit document. Before you start Employee Master shows the employee as On notice or Left , with leaving date, reason, company, cost center, and final job/pay details updated. The leaving date has arrived; settlement cannot be submitted before that date. Payroll Setup has valid salary, provision, loan, and Salaries Payable/Recoverable accounts and any notice pay elements. Leave up to the leaving date is decided. Any salary months allocated to Payroll Run have a posted run containing the employee; months allocated to the settlement cannot have a run past Draft. Approval Configuration for Final Settlement is ready if approval is required. Step by step 1. Open Final Settlements and choose an employee on notice or marked Left with a leaving date. Only one settlement exists per employee. 2. Review the salary months listed. The leaving month is paid through the settlement; earlier unpaid months can be assigned either to a payroll run or to the settlement, subject to the sequence shown. 3. Review calculated lines for salary, unpaid/paid leave, gratuity, leave salary, accruals, loan balance, any salary still held a Salary released line, paid from Salary held , and any arrears or monthly inputs. Confirm the chosen salary basis and rates against the employee's compensation and Payroll Setup. 4. Enter notice days and choose whether notice is paid in lieu or deducted for short notice. Add other earning/deduction elements only when supported by the relevant business decision. 5. If an automatically calculated gratuity, leave salary, or accrual amount must be overridden, enter the agreed amount and a reason. Check all warnings and the final net: a positive amount is payable; a negative amount is due from the employee. 6. Save the draft and submit on or after the leaving date, once the employee's clearance clearances.html is complete where the company uses one ; its amounts to recover are already deduction lines "Clearance: IT" . The system recalculates, checks leave and salary month dependencies, and routes through Approval Configuration. Rejection returns it to Draft. 7. Final approval posts the settlement journal dated on the leaving date. Review the journal and settlement status, then create a payment from the configured bank file or cash/bank account. If sent through Interim Payroll, pay it there instead; do not pay it twice. 8. If a posted settlement is wrong, reverse its payment first, then reverse the settlement with a reason. Reversal restores loan recoveries and returns the document to Draft for correction. The end of service statement Print statement at the top of a saved settlement prints the End of Service Settlement Statement to give the employee. It prints without the ERP title bar, like other documents sent outside. It shows: the company and the employee: employee no., name as in passport, nationality, passport and Emirates ID numbers from Employee Documents , designation, department, joining date, last working day, reason for leaving and length of service; the gratuity worked out: the basic, a day's pay and, for each slab, the years, the days a year and the amount; the cap if it applied; an amount HR changed, with its reason; the entitlements salary to the last working day, leave salary, accruals, notice pay, other additions and the deductions loans, leave taken in advance, other deductions ; the net, in figures and in words, in the system currency the currency marked Default in Currency Configuration ; signature lines for preparer, approver and the employee's acknowledgement. Until the settlement is posted, the statement is marked DRAFT , so you can check it with the employee first. A draft shows the figures as they are worked out now, the same as the screen.
